Ah, Amura Sushi Cafe in Virginia Beach. The name itself rolls off the tongue with a certain...unremarkable quality. Yet, I found myself within its unassuming embrace, a critic venturing into the culinary unknown with the weary resignation of a seasoned traveler enduring yet another layover.
The "atmosphere," as the common parlance dictates, was...present. Tables existed, chairs stood dutifully, and the lighting possessed a functional luminescence that neither offended nor inspired. One might say it achieved a state of beige neutrality, a canvas upon which the true test would be painted: the food and the dreaded "service."
The sushi, I confess, held a whisper of promise. The cuts of fish, while perhaps not possessing the breathtaking artistry of a Parisian master, displayed a commendable freshness. The rice, that often-overlooked foundation, was appropriately vinegared and possessed a pleasingly yielding texture. It spoke of a certain diligence, a refusal to succumb to utter mediocrity.
And the service...well. It was, dare I say, almost...pleasant. My server, a pleasant woman with an earnest demeanor, navigated my inquiries with a surprising degree of competence. There were no theatrical pronouncements, no unnecessary flourishes, simply an efficient and almost respectful attention to my needs. A stark contrast to the often-cloying solicitousness that plagues lesser establishments.
In conclusion, Amura Sushi Cafe is not a culinary revelation that will send tremors of delight through the gastronomic world. It is, however, a perfectly acceptable establishment that delivers precisely what it promises: edible sushi served with a modicum of efficiency. It lacks the soaring ambition of a true artist, but it also avoids the egregious missteps of the truly inept. It exists, and in its quiet competence, it manages to be...satisfactory. A word I rarely find cause to utter, yet one that, in this instance, feels surprisingly appropriate.

First off, the food was delicious. I ordered the chicken wings with shrimp fried rice and shrimp egg roll, and. The chicken wings were cooked perfectly, even the fried rice was flavorful and not greasy at all. The service was fast and friendly. Portions are generous for the price—definitely great value. I also appreciated how clean and organized the restaurant was, even during the lunch rush. For a reliable, no-fuss Chinese food fix, Chen's Kitchen on Tidewater Drive is a true neighborhood gem. It has become our go-to spot for takeout, consistently delivering on flavor, speed, and friendly service. The folks running the kitchen clearly take pride in their work, and it shows in the quality of the food.
The menu is packed with all the familiar favorites you'd hope for. On our last order, the General Tso's chicken was a standout—perfectly crispy even after the drive home, and coated in a sauce that had just the right balance of sweet and spicy. The fried rice is always fluffy and well-seasoned, and they don't skimp on the fresh vegetables, which is a huge plus. Portions are generous for the price, making it a great value for a family dinner or for having leftovers the next day.
The only reason it’s not a perfect five stars is a minor inconsistency with some of the appetizers. While the main dishes are almost always on point, we’ve found that items like the crab rangoon can sometimes lack that fresh-made magic, tasting more like they came from a frozen box. It's a small critique for an otherwise excellent kitchen.
Still, when you want dependable and delicious American-Chinese classics served up fast by a friendly crew, Chen's Kitchen is one of the best choices in Norfolk. We’ll definitely be calling them for our next takeout night.

2. If you want utensils you have to ASK the server during night time takeout. What kind of unnecessary rule is that you made up to give customers inconvenience? Or blame the inconvenience to customer that I didn’t know their rule? No service whatsoever.

On top of that the restaurant is outdated and seems short staffed with only one server running around during a busy dinner hour. Out of courtesy, I ordered takeout but the overall experience left me disappointed. As a flight attendant, I’ve traveled widely and tried Thai food in many places, and sadly, this was one of the least satisfying experiences.

I’m leaving 2 stars because I know running a family restaurant is difficult, but that shouldn’t be an excuse for poor food quality, confusing policies and lack of basic service.

Tida Thai offers wonderful hospitality and delicious food.

Still serving some delicious food with friendly service! Enjoyed the Chicken Lettuce Wraps with minced chicken with carrot, mushroom, water chestnuts topped with scallion. RECOMMENDED!! 😋

It was a pick two of every part of the menu (appetizers, drinks, entree, bread, and dessert), which honestly $70 was a really good deal considering that we have about a meal and a half left in leftovers.  We had the Veg Samosa and Tikki Chole** for appetizers, Goan Curry** (with chicken) and Chana Masala for entrees, garlic naan** for bread, kheer and Mango Kulfi** for desserts, and a Mai Tai and Blackberry Margarita** for drinks (** indicates the one we preferred, often by a long shot).  Their chicken in the goan curry was especially good—it melted in our mouths and was very flavorful with the curry. I’ve had better food from a food truck. Waited 20 minutes for the check. Came in around 4:30 in the afternoon. Wasn’t busy at all. Everyone working like it’s super busy. Would be better if service was better.

This Jose Tequilas is located in the Little Creek section of Norfolk along E. Little Creek Rd.  The closest exit for the place from I-64 is exit 278 which brings you to Chesapeake Blvd.  It is basically where N. Military Hwy, Chesapeake Blvd., and E. Little Creek Rd. meet.  Because of how traffic flows are, you will want to go onto N. Military Hwy to E. Little Creek Rd.  My visit here was on January 18, 2025.

I don't come over to this area very often.  I was out this way for our departmental luncheon.  There is another location close to where I live, so I figured this would still be good too.  There was ample parking when I arrived.  It wasn't too busy when I came in, but I think the rainy weather that day may have kept some away.  The inside of the place is pretty big, so I could tell that they would easily be able to accommodate a group of our size.  The overall ambiance of the place was inviting and has those Mexican vibes to it.

Even though everyone wasn't there yet, our server came to the table and checked each time as others arrived to find out what drink(s) we wanted.  I did stick with water with lemons, as I don't do the sodas and such.  Within a 15 minute window, everyone arrived and we  were checking over the menu options.

After some time and chatter, the server came around to get our orders.  I decided to go with the Top Shelf Queso as an appetizer and the Super Burrito with Chicken entree.  I normally don't do the tortilla, but I figured I would this time.  After everyone ordered, it would be about 5 minutes or so when all the appetizer orders came out.

The Top Shelf Queso was really good.  It had a good flavor to it.  I didn't eat the whole thing of course, so I did bring the rest home afterwards to consume then too.  About 10 minutes after the appetizers came out, the entrees came out to the table.  The Super Burrito looked really good too.  It was hot so I had to wait a moment to start on it.  The burrito was really good.  The flavors complemented very well.  I have been in diabetic remission for about 19 months and counting as of the time of this review.  I was pleasantly surprised that in the end, I did not get any major glucose spikes from the meal that day too.

Overall, the food, service and atmosphere were phenomenal.  The food was really good.  The servers were on it for all of us during that visit too.  They were quick to check and make sure there were no issues and were quick to keep the water cups full too.  You will definitely get the Mexican atmosphere here.  If you happen to be in that part of Norfolk and looking for a Mexican restaurant, this place is definitely worth coming to.

We've been there 3 times within two weeks after we've discovered this place. I am all smiles and in a great mood when we dine there. Such fun upbeat music and a cozy relaxing atmosphere. In the evening our group got in a festive mood just by enjoying the welcoming interior, the fun music, the big delicious meals and the mexican decorations everywhere. The food is so tasteful and the value for the money is good. The staff is super attentive and friendly. There is always enough parking and we've never had to wait.
customer_insights: Jose Tequilas Mexican Grill and Bar is a vibrant and welcoming spot in Norfolk, known for its attentive service and delicious Mexican cuisine. Guests rave about the friendly atmosphere, making it an ideal place for casual gatherings, family outings, or a fun night out with friends.

address: 4616 E Princess Anne Rd suite b, Norfolk, VA 23502, USA
googleReviews: Everything here 10/10 i loved the Lengua. The lady that took my order was so nice and the dining area was big. It looks smaller outside. Best tacos in VA so far, i can't wait to come back!

The BEST Mexican food is the ones that look like a “hole in the wall”! And this place was amazing! From the service to the taste of the huge Horchata and yummy food!
We will be coming back for more!!!!!

I had the lengua, cachete, and pastor tacos which were absolutely delicious! I absolutely love lengua and I’m always excited to find a new place that serves it up right.

If you are in the mood for some tacos, definitely check this place out.

I visited after church for the very first time. The ambiance is amazing...colorful, happy, inviting. Though they didn't offer what I normally order when I go to most Mexican restaurants, they improvised. I did paid more than I'm used to paying for similar meals; but, the fajita meat and veggies were hot (like I like them) and delicious. Service was PHENOMENAL and the atmosphere was also great. The waitress is kind, fluently bilingual, very patient, professional and caring with EVERYONE. I had the privilege of talking with her for a while after eating and as she was clearing the tables and cleaning. She even took the time to describe dishes to me that I was not so familiar with. They have delicious, invigorating, infused waters and teas, which is different from many other restaurants. The pineapple version even has a little bit of "the mother" (pulp) in it. The "Jamaica" (hibiscus) one is lightly sweetened and fruity~tasting. Overall, I really enjoyed my visit and I look forward to visiting again soon!
Food was very good we got an asada burrito, asada fries and a taco dish with refried beans. Everything was so fresh and well seasoned. Highly recommend and I'll be back.
customer_insights: Taqueria El Viejon is a highly-rated casual Mexican eatery in Norfolk, known for its authentic tacos and friendly service. Customers rave about the vibrant atmosphere and the quality of the food, making it a great spot for casual dining and social gatherings.

address: 4201 Granby St, Norfolk, VA 23504, USA
googleReviews: Mi Hogar was my favorite spot in college, but my recent visit was disappointing. The chicken was tasty, but the beef was bland. Service was poor—my coke arrived after the food, no refill, and a mix-up with my to-go cup. They got my chicken enchilada order wrong, but the chips and amazing cheese dip were a highlight and just a great as I remember

After a trip to sight see I insisted that I take my children to a local authentic Mexican restaurant. We were not disappointed, the Tortilla Chips and Salsa hit the spot and helped tide us over until our meals arrived. I ordered the CN Special- so delicious! We didn't have to wait long, but we all dug into our meals before we could take pics- it was so tasty!

Very mediocre and middle of the road Mexican food. We got the beef fajitas, taco salad, and chicken dish. It was decent. And atmosphere was fine. Service was definitely 5 stars — the waitress checked on us frequently and brought us our food quickly. When one of us left our phone, they brought it out to our car when we were leaving.

They started us out with chips and salsa which is always a win.

Price point was low to medium (~16-23 dollars a dish)

Ok I don’t leave reviews often but i have got to for this place esp through Uber eats it’s always a miss. This place went above and beyond from packaging to adding chips and salsa and all the condiments. I’m having a pity party over here missing my deployed spouse and eating my feelings away. I am so glad i found this place! Just look at the photos!!! And the prices are so decent!!! 😂 ignore my vacuum i was using it to prop my chips.

This place was just a hop, skip and a jump from Old Dominion University.  I used the google map feature to find a mexican place near the Chartway Arena.  When we arrived, around 3:30, it was pretty quiet.  We were served chips and red salsa right away.  Our drink orders were taken.  They arrived promptly.  The menu was full of lots of options.  The server was knowledgeable regarding the menu items.  He assisted me in deciding on his fave of the 4 dishes i had narrowed my choice to.  I selected the pork carnitas.  They were hot and delicious.  The verde sauce was a little thin and served on the side, however, they were very good.  We were very pleased with our impromptu mexican meal.
customer_insights: Mi Hogar Mexican Restaurant is a casual dining spot popular among families and students, offering a variety of Mexican dishes. While some reviews highlight inconsistent food quality and service, others praise the atmosphere and affordability, making it a decent choice for a quick meal or pregame gathering.

address: 2007 S Military Hwy Unit A, Chesapeake, VA 23320, USA
googleReviews: We ordered to go 3 Baja California grilled shrimp tacos and 3 Birria tacos with consome. The shrimp was well cooked, and the pieces of shrimp were big. The tacos shrimp I had at other restaurants is usually small. It was very tasty. The Birria tacos had great flavor, juicy, and very well served. Authentic Mexican food and reasonable prices. We will come back for more.

This has become our favorite Mexican restaurant. Food is amazing with HUGE portions. We didn't make a reservation so we had to wait 5 minutes. Service was fast, but the food was not out like you expect, too fast like most Mexican restaurants. It was still quick, but it was worth the slightly longer wait (still pretty fast). Our server was amazing. She kept our drinks full and when the salsa didn't taste like the first bowl (yes we had seconds) she brought us a fresh bowl and made us try it in front of her to make sure it was right. Be prepared to ask for a box. I ate my whole meal because I'm a man, but I'm paying for it! Not sorry, so good!

The staff here was very nice.they promptly seated our party, although the bench seat to our table was broken and we literally had to fix it ourselves in order to sit down, it was not a deal breaker .We received chips and dip right away along with our drinks. Two of our entrées did not come  with the ingredients as listed on the menu. We inquired about the missing ingredients and was assured it was prepared correctly so we just accepted our fate..even though I feel i didn't receive what I ordered the food was still pretty good!
One of our favorite places. All of the Hacienda locations are fabulous. We either dine in or take out a few times a month. Authentic Mexican food with a great atmosphere.  See you next week!

The food is good and flavorful! I’m not sure who the female hostess is with the long hair, but she definitely looks like she doesn’t like working here. I walked in and she looked like, why are u here to bother me. Hostesses are the face of the restaurant & should make guests feel welcomed to enter.
customer_insights: La Hacienda Street Food & Tequila is a popular spot for authentic Mexican cuisine, known for its generous portions and flavorful dishes. While the service is generally prompt, some diners have noted inconsistencies in their orders, but the overall experience remains positive with a lively atmosphere suitable for casual gatherings.

address: 1421 Colley Ave, Norfolk, VA 23517, USA
googleReviews:
Met my friend here for lunch  around 2 on a Sunday. Grabbed a table outside. Between the umbrellas and the trees, it was comfortably shaded. It wasn't very busy, although more patrons arrived after we were seated. Our server was very pleasant. I appreciated that he is bilingual. My friend got to order in Spanish and I did my best to practice my Spanish while ordering. We got the empanadas, chicken and beef. I liked the beef more. The chichirones were delicious with the big helping of Guacamole for dipping. Steak fajitas were delicious as well. I had never had, so I tried the nopales (cactus leaf) taco and lengua (cow toung) taco. Nopales just wasn't my thing, but I really liked the lengua.
Overall it was a great dining experience. I love the indoor decor and the comfortable atmosphere. I look forward to visiting again.

My to go tacos are steak with nopales 🤤 a delicious combination, drinks are amazing too!
Great option if you’re local or simply visiting! They also have enough  space for big parties!

Emily was our server she was friendly and patient.  Food was flavorful and fresh!!! Drinks where made with love. I can taste the drink but I can drive home safe. Yours neighborhood bartender. I don't know but I would've assumed this place was family owned with the care and love put into it.

We only sat at the bar. This place is wonderful! Great atmosphere fun vibe. Huge bar great indoor space. Nice outdoor space. Our bartender was Patricia, and she was amazing! She explained the happy hour and always had a smile on her face even though she was so busy. She checked up on us to make sure we were doing well. The food is nicely portioned. The drinks were great and we loved it. The staff is amazing! Will definitely be back.

The location, atmosphere was great. The food was bland no authentic Mexican seasonings on my Texas Faita , my steak was over cooked and dry my shrimp was overcooked, the rice was ok but still no seasoning. The house margarita I got was ok. I really enjoyed the chips and salsa dip the best that dip was amazing ask for more to go. Service was exceptional the waitress was attentive and very friendly.
customer_insights: Tacos y Tequila offers a vibrant atmosphere with friendly service and a diverse menu featuring authentic Mexican dishes. Patrons appreciate the outdoor seating and the quality of food, though some have noted inconsistencies in seasoning. It's a great spot for casual gatherings and pregame festivities.

address: 5957 E Virginia Beach Blvd, Norfolk, VA 23502, USA
googleReviews: This was a great experience from the moment we entered the restaurant. The staff was super friendly and helpful. Afraid was our server and you could tell he really enjoyed his job offering great suggestions and a positive attitude. This is honestly a place I would recommend. I also had the frozen margarita flight and believe me they are not stingy with the alcohol it’s enough for two. Did I mention the food was great? It was beyond appetizing.

I came by with my family for lunch and had a good experience. The service was fairly quick and friendly, so no complaints in that department! The food came quickly and was quite tasty. I did use a bit of hot sauce on my food, but that’s pretty typical at any Mexican restaurant. I would definitely recommend this place for a quick and affordable lunch!

The food was delicious,  the service was great - very attentive, the prices were reasonable. Serving sizes were generous. We enjoyed the atmosphere - music was playing in the background but not so loud we couldn't talk. We stayed longer than we usually would due to enjoying our time. I will definitely be back, even though it's a bit of a drive for us. I would highly recommend this for a gathering.

Mexican meals made better at an affordable price! Had ordered delivery multiple times from Casamigos then finally decided to stop in, was not disappointed. Service was excellent and food was amazing. Ordered the Pollo Casamigos to break from the ordinary and was amazed at the flavor complexity. Will be coming back soon!

Plenty of places can take a lesson from CAM restaurant. The customer service was first-class and impressive! I mean the service we received was straight bangin! The menu is packed with goodies, food and drinks. Truly enjoyed the experience and appreciate the care and consideration.
customer_insights: Casamigos Authentic Mexican Restaurant offers a vibrant and friendly atmosphere with attentive service and generous portions. Guests rave about the delicious food and strong margaritas, making it a great spot for both casual dining and gatherings.

address: 3629 Shore Dr, Virginia Beach, VA 23455, USA
googleReviews: Literally stumbled upon this place while staying on base. What a pleasant surprise! The food is fantastic! The servers are very friendly, upbeat and attentive. I’m not a rice and beans kind of girl I’d rather just have some great rice….lemme tell you….their beans are amazing! Lol! Scoop some of those beans on your chips from the chips and salsa and thank me later! ;-)

Do yourself a favor and get the shrimp and crab dip! Everything here is delicious but it was so good and the chips are the perfect balance of thin, crunchy, salty, and warm. The tacos governado were also really good, but they are a bit heavy because of the grilled cheese aspect. The portions are also HUGE. It literally took me 3 days to finish my meal. The rice and beans are also really good. The service is quick and it was not very busy so we got our food really fast. It’s also in a really good location if you’re at the beach or wanting to go to the beach after because the beach is just across the street. There is also parking.

Absolute best fajitas EVER! The chicken was tender and perfectly seasoned and the vegetables were cooked to the perfect texture. The rice and beans were delicious! This is an excellent value for a lunch special. The white sauce for the chips was amazing also. The salsa was tasty, but a bit spicy for me.

Jose Tequilas Cocina has become one of my absolute favorite restaurants in all Hampton Roads! Reasonable prices, amazingly consistent service which is always attentive but not pushy, delicious food that never disappoints, and literally some of the best tasting and kick-ass margaritas!! I’ve lived in San Diego for over a decade, eaten at amazing Latin cuisines all over the world, including Mexico and Spain. This place is a top tier restaurant that has a special place for both of us, and we have deemed it “our place” now! Really fun, non-pretentious, and great food and drinks!

Huge portions. Good, tasty birria tacos that were loaded with tender beef and gooey cheese.  Street tacos were equally good. They were very generous with their portions.

Attentive service... Everyone was chipping in to ensure we had everything we needed, from water to chips & salsa, to hot sauces. I wasn't sure who our waiter was anymore. Lol
customer_insights: Jose Tequilas Cocina Mexicana is a vibrant and friendly spot known for its delicious Mexican cuisine, including standout dishes like shrimp and crab dip, fajitas, and birria tacos. The casual atmosphere and attentive service make it a great choice for groups or a fun night out, especially for those looking to enjoy a meal before hitting the nearby beach.

address: 1207 N Military Hwy, Norfolk, VA 23502, USA
googleReviews:
I walked in on a Saturday. I was greeted right away by the gentleman behind the counter. I told him I wanted a burrito and I was starving. He recommended the Guapito Burrito:

Two tortilla quesadilla rolled into a burrito to your specifications of toppings, protein and salsas.

I went with the steak, pica de gallo , black beans, cilantro, lettuce, guacamole and he added a squeeze of lime for extra.

I got a water and paid. The young lady said I could take a seat and they would bring it out.

To my surprise they toasted the burrito!! 🙌 God bless you! 😆

It was phenomenal. It was massive as well. About the size of my forearm. I used a fork for scale in a photo.

Overall it was great. I will be back to try the Chorizo! ☺️

I came back on a Wednesday. The Birria Tacos were recommended to me. That’s what I got. Absolutely 🔥🔥🔥!!! Highly recommend. The broth was amazing too. Cheese was melty. Taco shell still had some crunch.

Love this place so much. Highly recommend if you want a yummy bite to eat for lunch or dinner.  Dine in if you can so it’s nice and fresh.

I will be back for more!!! 🥳

Stopped by while I was out and about and finally got to try the popular Birria Bombs. I usually just get a burrito bowl from here, so I was excited to try something different. The staff were all friendly and welcoming; answered questions that I had. The inside was partially decorated in a few areas for halloween.

The Birria bombs combo came with 3 Birria balls, sauce, and consomé (8/10) there was a good amount of cheese inside and a decent amount of meat, the flavor was pretty good, but I felt like the balls had too much dough. At one point in one of the balls, after a couple of bits, I had majority dough and a little sliver of meat. I also felt like the consomé wasn't as flavorful as I'm used to at other restaurants.

I don't think l'd try the Birria bombs in particular again, but I would like to try how their actual Birria tacos are at some point.

My overall rate of experience: 7.8/10

I rarely leave negative reviews but.....
I will NEVER order from this place again. First off, they charge 13% sales tax and the max limit for Norfolk is: 11.5%.  Their address is clearly in Norfolk and not in VB. That and they tack on 3.5% processing fee. Norfolk city treasurer, come investigate.
I had a large order, actually only for 4 people, but ended up spending $103.66???????
More reasons I will not return:
1. They added a dollar for guacamole. Menu doesn't state guacamole is an extra charge.
2. They charged me $1.59 for consome for my birria quesadilla. Looking at the pic I provided, I did not get any consome. I was PISSED when I got home an discovered this.
3. They charged me $9.96 for a large order of rice and $9.96 for a large order of refried beans where their menu CLEARLY states it's $2.49 for each. I argued that fact with them but the girl at the register wouldn't budge so now it's going on their review.
4. They charged me $1.96 for 4 habenero salsas where this charge is not found anywhere on their menu. They also charge $.50 for half a lime? Who does that? Oh, I know, This place.
5. Doing a large order at their ridiculous window is kind of impossible. Fine if you're coming in for lunch and maybe ordering a combo or 2 items but the person taking the order wouldn't take a whole large order. I had to piece the whole order together in between other people ordering. That and they don't understand English and don't even know their own pricing or portions.
Once again, never coming back. I don't care if they fix all this crap or get shut down for false advertisements and tax fraud.

FINALLY AN AMAZING MEXICAN PLACE IN NORFOLK!! We walked in and one of the co-owners walked us through the menu and we we loved all the food we ordered.  We’ll for sure be coming back! (Pic is of the birria bombs 😍)

LOVED this place & meal! The owner is so friendly & Cares about ea and every customer and also a Veteran. Skip Qdoba & Chipotle and come here instead; similar style concept (quick-serve), but w more authentic food.
The only downside is it's a very crowded little shopping center and parking sucks. But Still worth the visit 👍🏻👍🏻
customer_insights: Taco Burrito Co in Norfolk is a casual fast-casual dining spot known for its large and flavorful burritos and tacos, particularly the Guapito Burrito and Birria Tacos. While most reviews highlight the friendly service and delicious food, some customers have raised concerns about pricing transparency and order accuracy.

address: 738 W 22nd St #15, Norfolk, VA 23517, USA
googleReviews: Pelon’s burritos always deliver the freshest and juiciest burritos. My favorites are the Curl with fried shrimp added, Hawaiian pipeline with chicken, Hang Ten, and chips w/ guac or queso. Bring your stretchy pants because you will definitely enjoy the serving size and what other items you add to your meal. The location feels welcoming and spacious. There is plenty of parking, and they always handle the lines well.

Food is always excellent here. Have been twice when in town now and never been disappointed. Tacos are on point and tried a burrito, which was really big and flavorful. They have vegan brownies which are huge and soooo good too, along with vegan options on the menu. Food comes out fast too. Great experiences and will continue to go back when I'm in town!

Best fish tacos I’ve had in the area! We went for a late lunch on a Saturday and sat immediately at the bar. Plenty of tables if we wanted to sit there though. We ordered fish tacos, shrimp tacos and carne asada tacos. The Shrimp tacos were amazing, I wasn’t expecting them to be that good. The fish tacos by far are best that I’ve had in the area. Chill atmosphere, no frills, friendly staff.

My son and daughter-in-law flew in from CA to visit me. They are vegans who found this cafe online and decided to try it. On the other hand I am not vegan. They are strict vegans and I will eat almost anything. ANYWAY..the food was amazing and the portions sizable. The guy at the register couldn’t be kinder and more accommodating. This is definitely a cafe to check out!

I lived in San Diego for 10 years, I know something about fish tacos, these are good! Probably the best I have found in the eight years since moving away, but I still affirm that Rubio’s (a fast food joint) holds the standard and these fall just short. Not by much, but just short, the ability to dress your own goes along way!
The chips weren’t consistently salted, some were extreme and the salsa was unique. I enjoyed it but it won’t be for everyone, not chunky, but thin sliced tomato onion and pepper which I would consider Baja style.
The house margarita was ok but the Cadillacs was good.
My only complaint it that their payment system calculated tips with tax included which seems dishonest.
Overall ****
customer_insights: Pelon's Baja Grill is a casual dining spot known for its fresh and flavorful burritos and tacos, with a welcoming atmosphere and accommodating staff. The venue is suitable for various groups, including families and friends, and offers a range of vegan options, making it a versatile choice for diners.

address: 328 W 20th St, Norfolk, VA 23517, USA
googleReviews: First off Adrian, Manuel and Kayla are amazing!! First time here, and it was wonderful! The staff was very friendly professional and helpful. The food was great. The drinks were great. The atmosphere was fun. Nice happy hour. Wonderful indoor space. Nice outdoor space. Had a wonderful time. Will definitely be back.

I stopped by Jessy’s Tacos because I heard a lot of good things and the vibe definitely matched up — the staff was super nice, welcoming, and the place had a good energy to it. You can tell they care about making people feel comfortable, and that part really stood out to me.

The only disappointment was that they didn’t have ground beef available when I went. I specifically came in craving ground beef tacos, and unfortunately that option was off the menu that day. I ended up leaving a little let down since that’s what I had my taste buds set on.

Overall, it’s a friendly spot with a positive atmosphere, but if you’re heading there for something specific, I’d maybe call ahead to make sure they have it. With the service being great and the vibe on point, I didn’t want to give them a low rating — but since they didn’t have the main item I came for, I think 3 stars feels fair.

Outstanding food. The chips and salsa that they served as an appetizer were delicious. The chips were nice thick and crisp and the salsa was thick chunky and perfectly seasoned.

Probably the best chimichanga I’ve had in a long time. The salad was fresh, the rice was firm and perfectly seasoned, and the chimichanga itself was crisp without being burnt and nicely fried with no oily taste. Steak was nicely seasoned, and the refried came in a fried tortilla cup.

My wife had the flautas and was very impressed

My only knock on the place was that we had issues with flies indoor. I realize that with an outdoor seating area and the staff going in and out frequently that that can happen, but it really did take away from the overall enjoyment of the meal.

I will definitely be back.
Amazing service with some of the tastiest food I've ever had! Kevin did such an amazing job- and has such a beautiful smile. We will be back!

Great mex place near the viriginia zoo area. We stopped here for lunch after our zoo visit. This place definitely didn't disappoint. What a great taco selection. Got some veg, birrira, barbacoa lamb and beef tripe tacos on handmade corn tortillas. The tacos were out of this world. Very fresh, juicy and flavorful. HIGHLY recommend this place. Finished it with mangonada drink. Will definitely repeat this place.
customer_insights: Jessy's Taco Bistro is a vibrant and friendly spot known for its delicious tacos and lively atmosphere. The staff is attentive and welcoming, making it a great choice for casual dining or pregame gatherings. However, guests should check menu availability ahead of time for specific items.

address: Suffolk House, 4220 Monarch Way, Norfolk, VA 23508, USA
googleReviews: I had the Al Pastor tacos with beans and rice, phenomenal! I am very pleased with the service and the food being served. It should be more busy than it is. I highly recommend this place to anyone in the mood for tacos and a JUMBO margarita! 10/10
Been there in person and it wasn’t a bad experience. However the reason for a lower rating was this Door Dash. Please see the attached picture of an order of $10.00 guacamole. No bueno.

Went in late and they still took as in. The place is long In depth. Well placed sitting area, clean and airy. We were served by Tony. He was easy to deal with, able to assist us in ordering what we like. There were 7 of us but we were comfortable as there were only a few people then. So we can hear each other well. Tony was quick to give us great chips with dips while waiting. The orders came in fast. The food is Muy bueno. Presentation is good and the taste is well balanced. We enjoyed each of our orders. The salad was fresh, meat tender. We really enjoyed our experience.

I am part of a sorority organization called Zeta Tau Alpha at ODU that raises money for breast cancer education and awareness. We all put our heart and soul into this cause by planning events to raise money. Me and the head of our Philanthropy went around to all of the establishments around ODU campus to see who would be willing to donate a gift card or something of the sort to be used as raffle prizes at one of our biggest event this semester. This was the RUDEST interaction I had out of all of the places I asked. While I understand not wanting to donate anything, there is also no need to be rude. One of the managers basically said he couldn’t believe that anyone was buying into our cause, he said that he didn’t believe me and would need documentation, I offered to show him everything that I had and he looked at me like I was stupid and had such an attitude the whole time. He made me feel so embarrassed and out of place for asking. Me and all of the members of our chapter used to love going there for food and good times and I can assure that we will be spreading the word through campus and NEVER GOING BACK!  and for the record every other place we went to was more than happy to donate to our cause.
No brainer! Food was delicious and authentic.. service was outstanding and fast… the music and vibes had me shaking my hips in the booth!! (Chefs kiss) new spot!
customer_insights: La Herradura Mexican Restaurant & Cantina offers a lively atmosphere with authentic Mexican cuisine, particularly known for its tacos and jumbo margaritas. While the service is generally praised, there have been mixed experiences regarding customer interactions, especially concerning community engagement.

venueName: Lupita's Mexican and Latin American Restaurant
address: 9610 1st View St, Norfolk, VA 23503, USA
googleReviews:
Ordered a pork tamale, was given chicken. Went back in and requested a pork tamale and was told that chicken is now pork. I sucked it up and thought it might be good, it was not.
On top of bad food, Terrible service 0/10. There’s never any customers and now i know why.

This is my first time at the new location since Carmen's. So I started safe with the California burrito and an order of three Taco delinguas . The tacos were delicious soft and fresh corn tortillas with a good portion of meat well seasoned. The salsas we're also very good ,neither too hot, but the fresh tomato taste is very prominent, honestly incredible The layers it has. The California burrito was mostly potato and corn but I also think maybe my work boots and to-go order implied that I'd be eating this on the go so maybe it was out of consideration to kind of keep it tidy ,which if so I appreciate. Overall $45 was quite a price to not include rice or beans I did buy a soda as well lime jaritos* which was cold and refreshing as always. It was very good, but authentic great Latin/Spanish food is kind of crowded market ,just on little creek alone. But as for a local ocean view establishment it's very good albeit pricey

I just recently moved to the same street that this little restaurant is on, and I’ve been here a few times for lunch. Very impressed by how fresh the ingredients are and how many authentic South American dishes they offer. The service has been great as well, and the restaurant’s atmosphere is cozy and homey. Truly an underrated hole in the wall.

10/10, would recommend if you’re a lover of South American food.
Literally the best Mexican place I’ve ever been to. Absolutely delicious, fantastic service, and authentic food. Give it a chance and you WONT regret it. Love the Mexican burrito with sweet sauce. 😍😍

rice is bland, tamale is a joke is like liquid corn soup poured on top of the husk, beans are liquified, nothing tastes authentic let alone appetizing. not mexican food. service is good though and the place is decorated nicely.

googleReviews:
What's up? Wah Gwaan is Jamaican for what's going on, or what's up? Don't be fooled by the location of this somewhat newer Jamaican restaurant in an outlet mall. It's indeed 100% authentic Jamaican fare.

I've had my eye on Wah Gwaan all year. They opened in December 2024 and will celebrate one year next month. The location is convenient by H&M. So my suggestion is to park by the bus loop.

I noticed most customers carry out. Either way customers order at the counter where there is a menu. I dined in and they do a nice full service china, silverware and table cloth for customers which I really appreciated. They also offer a small bar with wine and beer.

They offer a small menu to focus on what they do best. The friendly owner with Jamaican accent took my order. I could not resist getting their oxtails which is a traditional dish, side of cabbage and brown rice with peas. My wife also got a traditional dish of Curry chicken with side of cabbage with white rice and peas. They offer bottle drinks only.

The wait was very short for small rice bowls which we both loved! Then maybe 10 more minutes tops mains rolled out. The food looked and smelled amazing! I chatted up the young lady owner about the place. She said it owned by her and Uncle whom is the cook.

My wife first. The Curry Chicken was plentiful and good, but she was a bit overwhelmed by the spice as not use to it. The cabbage is different, she thought it was just ok. Although not perfectly to her liking she enjoyed. My oxtails were the bomb! Tender, juicy packed with flavor. If new to oxtail be prepared for a lot of bone which is normal. Oxtail is the meat off the tail of a cow. I enjoyed the cabbage, it was fresh and crispy, a different take.

The portions are served liked dinner entrees, so expect large. Outside of oxtail $26 which is considered a delicacy the items are around $12+. On my opinion fair. Check out at the counter was smooth. You can tip off the card.

My overall is I'm impressed with the business, the authenticity of the food and kindness of the staff. My wife was not as big a fan of her dish, but still did enjoy. I think they can retool the experience for customers eating in. Table service and check out would polish them up. This may be too challenging with staffing. 4.5 rounding down and I would return and recommend.

Oh man, let me tell you, those ox tails were absolutely amazing! I've searched high and low in Norfolk for good ox tails, but every time I've been let down, so much so that I've had to toss the whole plate away. But now I've discovered a place that serves them just the way I like it. I can only hope and pray that they'll be consistently delicious because every bite was a delight. I didn't even want to share with anyone, but I had to so they could experience how tasty it was, rice and all. I'm just overjoyed to have finally found a spot that cooks ox tails perfectly and tastes so divine. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

The ladies that work there are beautiful.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

VR

address: 5511 Faris St, Norfolk, VA 23513, USA
googleReviews: First of all, I'm not from Virginia so I know that coming down south eating West Indian food could be a little more pricey than coming from the north. I bought one beef patty and it cost $5.73. they gave me the most. Driest nastiest beef patty I've ever tasted in my life. It tastes like it came out of a box. I am highly disappointed.

My husband and I visited this restaurant from a suggestion of one of the children at his school( he works lead security in Norfolk Public Schools)
He ordered the oxtail with rice Peas and gravy, collard greens, and macaroni and cheese, but they misheard and also have him green beans.
I ordered the fried whiting dinner with collards and cabbage with a side of yams. OMG,  the portions were huge and split for dinner Saturday and lunch on Sunday ( it may be my Sunday Dinner)

My wife and I flew in and were looking for lunch, this place came up and we decided to come by. A soul food restaurant was on my list of places to try as well. I got the oxtail, my wife got the jerk chicken. Everything was seasoned perfectly, but I can see how some people would say this was over seasoned (Jerk chicken is supposed to be HEAVILY seasoned, look up other recipes lol). The chicken itself was a flavor explosion. The oxtail was fall of the bone tender, almost creamy because of the amount of fat and tenderness that the dish had. When the sauce mixed with the beans and rice, it was simply one of the most flavorful, umami flavor you could dream of. Both her and I had the Mac and cheese, then we also had the cabbage and collard greens. The Mac and cheese was a pretty standard Mac and cheese that I would compare to homemade (made from scratch cheese sauce). The collard greens and cabbage were packed with flavor, seasoned with spices that I don’t know the name of, and cooked to perfection.

I at least told the lady working the counter that I put my dining experience in her hands, and she did not disappoint. She was very friendly in her recommendations, service, and overall demeanor. Food also came out quickly (within a few minutes).

Atmosphere is where I took off a little bit due to the dimly lit area, slightly sticky tables (although still clean), and loud music. It is worth noting that we were sitting right next to the speakers and I do feel this would be much better if we sat elsewhere

Price was very fair, but the oxtail was more expensive (comparatively to the rest of the menu) pushing the pricing band into the mid 20s per person. It is reasonable to be within the 10 to 20 per person price range without getting the oxtail. But you totally should because it was amazing

Amazing food, amazing service. The staff was nice and accommodating. The music they were playing in the restaurant was amazing (R&B classics). It felt like I was at a family members house. I ordered the whiting plate with cabbage and mac n cheese and yams. The mac was amazing esp for a Caribbean spot. Everything was hot and fresh and delicious. No notes

This is my second time getting food from them and I tried a lot of Jamaican food spots in the 757 area but this beats every spot I’ve been to. I don’t know why or what going on with the bad reviewers taste buds but the food here is amazing and have so much flavor. The oxtails are huge and not tiny . My only complaint is  I’ve been here for 5 years and no one ever told me about this place lol

I rarely leave good reviews I only review based off expirence All jokes aside . Food is cooked with love
10 out of 10

A hidden gem. My sister recommended this place and I was very happy with my oxtails and jerk chicken. The owner was very nice and gave me a healthy portion. Great authentic flavor

address: 977 Reon Dr STE 102, Virginia Beach, VA 23464, USA
googleReviews:
Absolutely phenomenal! Desmond’s is a true culinary gem in the Virginia Beach/Norfolk area—a rare find where flavor, creativity, and quality come together perfectly. I tried the guava lentil balls, pumpkin curry, roti, channa, and cabbage, and every single bite was packed with flavor and clearly made with care. If you’ve got a sweet tooth, do not skip the banana pudding—it’s the perfect finish to an unforgettable meal.

Enatye Ethiopian Restaurant at 275 Sunset Park Dr, Herndon, VA 20170

address: 930 Briar Hill Rd B, Norfolk, VA 23502, USA
googleReviews: LarderRoom...Lillys Corner is such a hidden gem in Norfolk. If you know you know. Everything is fresh and made to order. It's one of the only places I know of to get African food in Hampton Roads. If there is a special, get it. Look for the whole snapper or the dibi grilled lamb (or chicken). They also have some great homemade drinks. Enjoy.

You can smell the food as you’re parking right outside the restaurant! Very cozy unassuming place, right next to a Jr. Market/gas station. Outside you can see giant signage covering the windows with pictures of their entrees. As you enter, the great smell of food envelopes you. You get transformed into a world of Senegalese/African motif - bright yellow, burgundy, green patterned wallpaper, repeated onto fabric table covers protected by plastic liners. There is seating for 28, combination of booths and chairs.
You are then greeted with a smile and hello. I quickly said my hello and made a remark that it’s my first time and that not sure what to select. I was asked what I feel like eating - fish? Chicken ? Lamb? It’s a good thing I came well informed from the Yelp reviews- so I ordered Beef Fataya and Chicken Thue Curry. I also ordered poisson frit (fried fish) to go for dinner!
The beef fataya came out within 5 minutes. It came in 4 pieces, enough for a meal, with a few fresh chopped  lettuce leaves and sauce in a tiny container. They look like empanadas! Very delicious with fresh ground beef. The sauce how ever little packs some spicy punch!!!!!
While waiting for my other dish I am entertained by some humming and singing in the kitchen. Is that part of the service?
Then the chicken Thue Curry came out. The curry comes with fufu, served in to go containers and plate for you to
enjoy portions as you dine in.
The curry came with 2 small drumsticks and two chunks of bone in, fall off the bone chicken and deep orange carrots and potatoes all cooked to Perfection. The fufu looks like a deeper yellow mashed potatoes but tastes like less fibrous cassava!  You can smell the curry but when you start to eat, the curry is different from the Thai curry or Indian curry - they seem to use other spices- different but delicious! The temperature was hot, you know the food wasn’t heated up from refrigerated or frozen state.
I would come back to try all other dishes. Will definitely add the review for the poisson frit when I eat it for dinner tonight!

Update Aug: I ordered online and got the fish yassa and nems (egg rolls) and bissap drink this time. The fish came with white rice and sautéed onions, the fish was seasoned really well and the white rice was also seasoned well. The nems / egg rolls came with three sauces and they tasted pretty good.

I ordered the lamb mafe and the beef fataya. The lamb mafe was a stew with slight peanut flavor that was interesting in a good way and the beef fatay was like empanadas and had good flavor

I thoroughly enjoyed my dining experience at Mr Shawarma Virginia Beach this past weekend. Once I did order, the portions were extremely generous for a very fair price, and the food was tasty. I decided to eat at the restaurant, and was impressed at the cleanliness of the dining area. Would highly recommend a visit if you're in the area and craving some Shawarma!

The food is the same as the Norfolk location, always fresh and hot. The falafel are amazingly soft and moist on the inside with a nice crunch on the outside.

If you're in the mood to try something new or you LOVE mediterranean, we HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

While the portions have been noted to decrease in size, the quality of food and friendly service remain highlights. googleReviews:
It was a very nice experience. The vibes and the decoration are great. Food is amazing. The owners are great hosts. The staff are very helpful especially Malak whose recommendations helped us have a wonderful yummy family dinner.
We were so lucky that Mr.Mamdani was there enjoying this great place too.

I had an amazing experience at Al Bawadi. The food was truly delicious — rich, fresh, and full of authentic Middle Eastern flavor. Everything was served beautifully and the quality was outstanding. One of the best Eastern meals I’ve had in a long time. Highly recommended!

Bawadi is a delightful Jordanian-American owned restaurant serving cuisine of the Levant and tucked away in the seven corners area near Falls Church.  I recommend the mint lemonade which is blended on demand and worth requesting without sugar - it has a cool, refreshing, and - I’m told -authentic flavor.  The menu is colorful and sensibly laminated as we kept it around to order several times during our stay.  Familiar options are available including the crowd pleasing hummus, baba ganoush, and Arabic salad we decided to share - all served with puffed-up khubez served warm from a massive stone oven; the manufacture of piles of bready pillows can be observed through plexiglass in the center of the restaurant.

The ambiance is meant to give the feel of a Bedouin camp and I recommend sitting outside in the beautiful nooks one might find on a journey through the Wadi Rum.  Artworks of the region are throughout the rooms and while it may be a bit over the top at times, including a massive image of Petra, it does add to the adventure. Traditional textiles adorn the space and some are for sale too along with sweets to go; various dialects and languages are heard as crowds of expats and locals from distant suburbs trek here not unlike traders passing through Rose City in the 1st century.  The charming namesake sunflower, a vestige from the previous vegetarian restaurant, remains carved on the ceiling.

Bawadi is known for its popular luncheon buffet which, as we had planned, had just concluded as we arrived around 330 on Sunday.  We chose the traditional lamb qidra as a main dish and also the shrimp kabob - they pleased by their aroma and taste equally.  I did wish that we had tried the mansaf or the stew of the day, but as an unexpected friend arrived as we had just finished our first dishes we hastily ordered the qidra again to ensure she had a chance to sample this great dish - this time with chicken.

I might have preferred a large glass for the freshly blended and thick mint lemonade we all selected versus the lidded-cup with small diameter straw, however this did encourage a slower consumption rate and minimized the  chance of spills as we were there quite a long time reaching across the table sharing family style.

After our feast we selected sukseh - aka Arab lazy cake - as we exited the restaurant.  At home we regretted not bringing home the heavily pistachio-ed baklava which looked amazing - next time?

This is a hidden treasure, it does not get enough hype. The food hits, the music is a vibe, and the people who work here are so nice. You can tell they take pride in their cooking and genuinely want you to enjoy it, which is rare nowadays.
Authentic Palestinian food. Chicken kabob combo was delicious and perfectly cooked. Mint lemonade was perfectly blended. Highly recommended 👍🏼
customer_insights: Bawadi Mediterranean Grill is a hidden gem known for its authentic Middle Eastern cuisine and warm hospitality. Guests rave about the delicious food, particularly the lamb qidra and mint lemonade, and the inviting ambiance that evokes a cultural experience.

address: 813 W 39th St, Norfolk, VA 23508, USA
googleReviews: Family owned and operated and the owners are the sweetest!  Been here several times and it's always delicious! Spicy sweet potatoe burrito has Indian curry vibes. The turkey bacon Swiss sandwich is one of the best sandwich melts I’ve had in a long time! We also got the green goddess salad and a side of the kale salad which were also excellent. All of it was so delicious! Great service too.

Where do I start? I had the most wonderful experience at Honeysuckle Cafe.
Ambiance is a 5: definitely cute on the outside, inviting with a nicely painted porch and seats. As you enter you are welcomed by walls with colorful canvas artwork (which are for sale and painted by a local artist!). Cute decor with plants give it a homey feel. Dining area seats 14. There is a window view to the outside porch and surrounding area.plenty of parking.

Service is a definite 5: you’re greeted with a smile as you enter. I relayed that it’s my first time and the hostess/wait staff was so helpful telling me about their did used on the board and their popular items.

I ordered the green goddess sandwich with chicken salad (you can alternatively order chickpea salad) and a side of kale salad. The sandwich was really delicious: fresh alfalfa sprouts, cucumbers, chicken salad. The kale salad had bacon and fresh grated Parmesan cheese. It was a tad salty but it probably just because of mg taste buds! I couldn’t finish the sandwich so I was given containers for my sandwich salad and was provided a foam cup for my coffee.

Now the super service treat: the owner Susan came out to chat with another customer. And lastly: apologies to the wonderful hostess/waitress - I unintentionally gave her extra cleanup work as I spilled my coffee on the porch!  Will definitely make ig up to her she. I come back for Saturday brunch!

Highly recommend this cafe, a true gem in Colley!

Family owned & operated this gem is our favorite spot any day of the week. Dynamic menu of comfort, health, creativity, and fun when it comes to the different specials featured throughout the week. If you’re looking for your next honey hole to eat with your family or sneak out by yourself, well it’s in the name itself. Definitely 10/10 recommended!

A truly wonderful hidden gem that I happened upon on a whim and I do not regret it.

The food quality is the freshest and tastiest I've had the pleasure of eating and understanding the care that goes into it. The pasta and broccoli salad was the most tender I've had (I learned the cooks cook it especially so for the elderly that frequent), the burrito was very well spiced and generously sized (I was asked about the spice level personally by the cook), and I was impressed down to the level of use of local hot sauce (and even given the location of where to purchase said sauce).

This location truly encapsulates caring and supporting the community as well as the customers. Please do give them a try if you find them.

If you enjoy hearty, filling breakfast with flavor, this is the spot.
customer_insights: Honeysuckle Cafe is a beloved family-owned establishment known for its warm ambiance and delicious comfort food. Customers rave about the quality of the dishes, the friendly service, and the community-focused ethos, making it a perfect spot for brunch or casual dining with friends.

address: 4878 Princess Anne Rd, Virginia Beach, VA 23462, USA

Got the meat pie. Super spicy. I couldn't handle it.

googleReviews: Fried Turkey wings.. Fried lamb chops.. cabbage.. look I drove 2 hours and 15 minutes for "THEE" food.. let's go delicious! Karaoke on Thursdays and a great happy hour menu! Great cocktails...

googleReviews:
Went here Sunday after church around 12:30 pm. No wait time and the restaurant was not busy at all. I came here hoping my experience would be better than the last, but that was not the case at all. I ordered from their apparent “new” brunch menu and was excited because the options all sounded delicious. My excitement quickly went away from the wait time for our food, which was ridiculous (0/10) especially when the restaurant wasn’t busy at all. There was also inconsistency among the presentation of food on each plate brought to the table.

I first asked for a mock tail, the Burner (8/10) it was refreshing and I wanted to enjoy it, but the drinks were brought out so quick and our food took 35-40 minutes… For food, I asked for their Loaded brioche French toast (3/10), the menu stated “sweet cream filling” as if the French toast would be stuffed with the cream inside; however, what I was given was thick slices of dry bread, overly smothered in strawberries, with the tiniest amount of cream thrown on top! No “filling” in the bread, at all. Bacon (8/10), Grits (9/10), Scrambled Eggs with cheese (4/10) very bland, and Potatoes (2/10) basic, bland, and unseasoned. Additionally, I found out after an order needed to be redone at my table, that my potatoes were actually supposed to come with seasoning and peppers.

My soror who came to brunch with me, had to give her food back after the long wait since her order was not correct at all. What followed, was the manager coming to our table, with what seemed like a bit of an attitude, trying to find out how exactly the order was wrong. While explaining that the French toast didn’t match the description of the menu, a simple conversation about the menu wording and food outcome/presentation turned into a partial over explaining and back and forth, with the staff almost refusing to accept that what was given to us simply didn’t match the menu description. After having the waitress and manager come to the table multiple times and after another long wait for food, my Sorors food arrived with an amazing presentation (I should’ve taken a picture of it). Definitely not how my food, my sisters food, or my sorors original plate of food looked at all.

Inconsistency is a major issue here as well as communication. There’s no reason going back and forth, doing any over explanation, or having to send your food back to be remade should THEN lead to you receiving well prepared/presented food here in this restaurant. The manager explained that the slow service and food presentation was because everyone in the kitchen was being “trained” and the brunch menu was still “new.” To me, this didn’t make sense when this restaurant is not new; the explanation/excuse used just didn’t add up.

Think I’ve given enough chances to this restaurant at this point. I’ve been here some other times and didn’t do reviews for those experiences, because they weren’t great, but they also weren’t terrible, but this recent experience has sealed the deal for me on not coming back; very unfortunate.

The waitress mentioned she would fix our bills to accommodate for the experience we had and while paying, I noticed that the only thing really removed from each bill was basically the tax total.

About $31 spent on my order.

My overall rate of experience : 4/10

I WOULD HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS RESTAURANT! You have a great experience.

⭐ 0/10 for Food • ⭐ 9/10 for Main Waitress • ⭐ 0/10 for Food Runner • ⭐ 8/10 for DJ/Drinks

My family of 20 has visited this restaurant three times in the past two months, and we came again this Friday to celebrate a birthday. We were seated near the bar. I always order the same thing— the turkey chops — because they’re usually crispy, crunchy, and perfect.

This time, the experience was completely different.

My family’s food came out fast, so we were excited. But when I started eating, my gravy was freezing cold, like it had come straight out of the refrigerator. I even asked my waitress to touch it so she could feel it for herself, and she immediately apologized and took it back.

When my plate returned, my sides were different than what I ordered. Instead of macaroni and candied yams, it came with yams and collard greens. That wasn’t a big issue mistakes happen — and she did bring out the macaroni afterward. But the turkey wings was still ice cold, Who want a soggy turkey chop ? and the turkey chop I requested “fried hard” was soggy, not crunchy, and clearly not fresh. It tasted like it had been sitting out, not freshly cooked, and the whole plate was cold.

I made sure my waitress knew I wasn’t upset with her. She was kind, professional, and clearly doing her best. The issue was 100% coming from the kitchen.

What really added to the bad experience was the person helping bring out the food. She was noticeably rude and kept acting irritated any time she had to walk around us — even though we were celebrating, dancing, and enjoying ourselves. Instead of walking around to serve people directly, she passed plates over people and had us passing them down the table like it was an offering plate. It felt unprofessional and lazy.

After this visit, I can honestly say I won’t be returning.
The food was a 0/10, the DJ and drinks were an 8/10, my waitress deserves a 9/10, but the food runner gets a 0/10 for attitude and service.

I would not recommend this location after this experience.

The biscuit was huge and delicious! Just the right amount of spice and sauce. The tots were hot and crispy. I recommend dipping them in the Comeback Sauce. The lemonade and sweet tea were delicious also!

Carry out, delivery and patio seating are the dining options. We sat at the tables outside and while it was fine, please be aware you will have birds sitting on the table right next to you. These birds have no fear. 😂 They obviously know how good these biscuits are too! Seriously though, if you are afraid of birds, the patio is probably not for you!

The portions are too small for the price point. The primary flavor is salt and there’s no option to get chicken AND bacon for the wraps. Also, the tea tasted like no one cleaned the tea container. Overall, I may not return to this location.

Reasonably priced, fast and friendly service.

I did not have a good experience here. Years ago, before I had a gluten allergy, I dined at the Suffolk location and loved the food and service. Now that I have an allergy I’m very mindful about where I eat. I called ahead to the Norfolk location and asked if they had any gluten-free options and was reassured that they could “make anything on the menu gluten free” I took that loosely because usually restaurants don’t have separate gluten free friers so my expectation was that I could perhaps get a burger with no bun, grilled wings, or a rice bowl. A few hours later I went with my husband and we were seated within a couple minutes. When trying to order I asked the waitress if their wings or burger patties were gluten free. She said let me go check and see and came back with a no. Then I asked what they had that was gluten free expecting there would be another option based on my earlier phone call to the restaurant. She went back and asked the cook and he said nothing in the restaurant was gluten free. We drove 30 minutes just to have to leave. The waitress was sweet and I could tell she felt bad but there wasn’t anything else to be done. My husband enjoyed his basil lemonade and she comped it but the overall experience was disappointing because I never would’ve driven that far knowing that there wouldn’t be anything for me to eat. I don’t expect restaurants to cater to my allergy but if I’m told on the phone very confidently that there is gluten free food for me and then we waste time and gas to go I feel pretty frustrated. If you don’t have an allergy this restaurant may be a good choice but I likely won’t be going back which is disappointing.

I wanted to surprise my family with a home cooked meal. I live in Dallas and wasn’t familiar with the restaurants in Virginia Beach. Someone told me to try Ellen’s. They said they couldn’t believe the large portions and how delicious the food was! I am going to Ellen’s as one of my “go to “ restaurants in the future.

I was staying across the street at the Founders Inn and walked across the street for a quick bite to eat.  Very friendly service and the food was delicious!  You can tell that the owner really cares about the business and serving people. When I was there, there were a bunch of regular customers that she seemed to know well and really loved her.

Very small but cozy place. I was greeted by great smelling cooking from the kitchen. I then was greeted with a welcoming smile and as I explained that it's my first time, I was asked what I was craving for to which  I replied "fish!" I was immediately recommended the catfish - which I used to eat when I was growing up in the Philippines. I could get 2 fillet meal for $14.99 or 1 fillet meal for $13.99 - that extra dollar for another fillet was too hard to pass up!
There were many choices for 2 sides that came with the meal but I picked collards and potato salad. The other choices were Cole slaw, rice, cabbage...
I say on the line chair while waiting for my meal to be prepared. Had to be takeout as there aren't chairs or tables. I was able to admire the unique art pieces and display: including a mirror with colorful plastic utensils as backdrop
for the mirror.
I got to taste my meal and it was delicious and heart warming - a hug for my tummy: the catfish fillets were perfectly seasoned and not burnt or oily. Collard greens were cooked perfectly and the potato salad was hearty.
Can't wait to try the other fish meals. Highly recommend this place!

Why don’t you have an actual picture of your Mac and cheese on the website? It is gross!! And plain. customer_insights: Ellen's Homestyle & BBQ LLC offers a cozy and friendly atmosphere with a focus on comfort food, particularly Southern-style barbecue. Kitchenfinity was the absolute best caterer we could have chosen for our wedding day and we’re so glad we found them! Maricen and Rich were amazing to work with from start to finish, making the entire process — from planning and tasting to setup and execution at our venue — effortless and enjoyable.

They were always available to communicate new ideas or accommodate any changes we wanted to make, including adding more items to our menu. We wanted a mix of both Filipino and American cuisine, and they absolutely delivered! Our guests couldn’t stop talking about how incredible the food was.

The graze and gather table for hors d’oeuvres and desserts was beautifully styled by Maricen and her team, and everything tasted just as amazing as it looked. Maricen also brought creative ideas to the table, like to-go ube smash burger boxes as a late-night snack which was a fun and delicious hit!

Overall, we can’t recommend Kitchenfinity enough for any special event!

The building doesn’t look like much as you drive in from Terminal Blvd but once you pull into the parking lot and are welcomed by cute outer space murals. There was also more creative art inside to keep you entertained and interested while visiting.  Service was delightful, food was delicious and atmosphere was clean and welcoming. The Nashville Hot Tots dish is like every perfect flavor combined into one basket and the Alpha smash burger was chefs’ kiss!  We can’t wait to return and try more menu items!
It’s truly a hidden gem.

Walked in because I wanted a smash burger, and that’s exactly what I got. Always a 10/10, food is always fresh and hot, I always end up eating almost half before I leave the parking lot. This is probably in my top 2 of favorite spots to go to when I visit Norfolk. I recommend everyone to try, the brisket loaded fries is my absolute favorite.

We went to LeGrand Kitchen for an evening date and had such a wonderful experience. Our waitress, Allegra, was attentive and made us feel well cared for the entire night. We ordered the burger with potato wedges—perfectly spiced and absolutely delicious. Honestly, it was the best burger we’ve had in a long time!

For dessert, we shared the chocolate chip blondie, and it was incredible - definitely something I’d come back for again. Overall, great food, great service, and a cozy atmosphere. Highly recommend!

Love love love.

This place is amazing. I personally appreciate the relaxed vibe with high end food!!!
Parking is tricky, if you’re not looking, you’ll miss it.

The burger is something my husband and I dream about!!!! It’s so so good. I only wish it came with two pickles lol

Service is always top tier. We’ve had several of their dishes and drinks, they never disappoint!

Thank you for existing and giving us…. THE BURGER!!!!

We showed up with no reservation on a Friday evening just a few minutes after they opened, we didn't even think about possibly needing a reservation! There were maybe 2 people in the restaurant so we didn't know what to expect, we didn't know we'd needed to call ahead! The hostess looked at the seating and reservation books for the night and graciously fit us in. I say "fit us in" because within 10 minutes the place started to fill in quick as people started showing up for *their* reservations!

Food:
We got the grilled cabbage appetizer and the pork belly appetizer, both were delicious! The grilled cabbage was our favorite.

My partner got the Legrand Burger and he really enjoyed it. It was a little on the juicy side so be careful! The bottom bun was a but soggy but the flavor was great!

I got the steak frite special. The steak was tender and the fingerling potatoes were the perfect size side.

The house sodas are so delicious! My partner got the pineapple passionfruit and he had to pace himself so he didn't gulp it all down before the food arrived.

Bathrooms:
There are 2 single stall bathrooms. They are gender neutral and very clean! There was a nice candle burning in there and a few tampons and toothpicks. Very thoughtful!

Overall, super happy with the service and food! Everyone was super friendly. It gets a bit loud as it gets busy but you can still hold a conversation. It's not super romantic, but if those are the vibes you're going for maybe go super early or much later. If you're a single diner or have no more than 4 people you could probably get away with not having reservations if you show up right as they open! Otherwise, you might want to make some reservations ahead of time.

Good food is healing, and LeGrand Kitchen knows the art of nourishment. The shrimp & grits were flawless—fresh, comforting, and bursting with flavor. The cornbread pudding was golden, sweet, and earthy, the kind of dish that lingers in your memory.

The chef’s commitment to quality ingredients and creative execution is undeniable. And while this meal was extraordinary, I’ll definitely be back to try their burger—I’ve heard it’s a masterpiece in its own right. This place is a true gem.

Had a wonderful dinner here tonight! The food was excellent, but the service truly made the experience. Our server, Katrina, was absolutely the best! She was attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed. We'll definitely be back, and we'll be asking for Katrina! Highly recommend this spot.
customer_insights: LeGrand Kitchen offers a cozy and relaxed atmosphere with a focus on high-quality food and attentive service. Diners rave about the burgers and unique dishes like shrimp & grits, making it a great spot for dates, casual gatherings, or a night out with friends.

Only critique is that this establishment is tucked off of the main road and can be a little hard to find, but put in the work because it’s worth it!

Both burgers were delicious, perfectly cooked medium- rare, juicy, with the toppings as described. The waffle-cut sweet potato fries good enough to be dessert. The brussel sprouts were out of season, tiny, so easily overcooked.
