What is there to say about a place like this?It's been here for 40 or 50 years.I used to eat here when I was 20 years old.Quality is decent and the portions are good and the services well. It's not high end , but you're also not paying high end prices
customer_insights: Manny's Burger is a beloved local spot in Norfolk, known for its hearty burgers and friendly service. While the atmosphere is casual and nostalgic, it may not be the ideal choice for a romantic date or special occasion.

address: 7750 Tidewater Dr Suite 301, Norfolk, VA 23505, USA
googleReviews: Such a great burger. The toppings bar was loaded with options. All of those add ons were fresh and looked delicious. Cleanliness was superb.

Flabbergasted!!!

2015 I  became intolerant to Gluten.   If consumed, I  would become a sort of "Elephant Man".  Woman in this case.  It has been quite a ride since.  Always longing to enjoy Pizza, Sandwiches, Empanadas, Doughnuts, and so forth.  Limited establishments offer Gluten-free food.  Those who do, enjoying the food is out of the question.  Bread crumbles into tiny pieces, when you grab it.  Once in your mouth, is like eating sand mixed with cardboard.

I was visiting my daughter, in North Carolina, and were cleaning Ocean View beach through her job in Virginia.  She looked in the internet for a restaurant that would serve Gluten-free food.  To our Surprise, Fuddruckers was first on the list.  Skeptical, she asked the internet, "Does Fuddruckers sell Gluten-free food?"  A big Yes came up. I said "Let's go there."  We were not far. In about 5 min, we were there.  Nice atmosphere.  I go to the counter and was greeted with a smile, and was asked what would I like to order. Of course, I  had to ask about Gluten-free.   She assured me the bun is Gluten-free.  I ordered my first burger in years.  When I bit into the delicious burger, I  experienced an old feeling of normal eating.   Yes, weird. I stopped eating, and went to the counter.  I asked "Was I given a Gluten-free bun?"  She said, "Yes". Then she proceeded to walk back to my table, and looked at my bun, and reassured me it is Gluten-free.  (No sèeds on bun) She asked me "What's wrong?"  I looked at her Flabbergasted and proceeded to inform her of my Gluten-free experience, and that this bread did not taste Gluten-free.   It did not crumble to tiny pieces, it had a great taste, and it was not sandy/cardboard.

She was happy I was enjoying my meal.  I thoroughly enjoyed the great 1/2lb burger with wonderful fries, and all the free fixings.  LOVED IT!!!  This experience was at Fuddruckers in Norfolk, Virginia.  I am from Florida.   We need a Fuddruckers in Green Cove Springs please, thank you.

Thank you Fuddruckers!!!
Greatttttt burgers, shakes, chicken tenders, etc etc etc. the fries were out of this world

First time here with my husband & toddler.. and let me say we absolutely loved it!! From the service to the atmosphere to the food, everything was incredible!!! I wanna give a special shout out to Patti!!! She is amazing. She is such a beautiful soul. Always making sure everyone was happy, cleaning up after everyone and making us feel at home. 10/10 will be coming back!!! Thank you Patti!!

I have been here twice in the past month and each time was a delight. The ordering process is simple with mock-upsbofbthe size of various buyer patties. (They do not disappoint)
Your food is cooked to order and the fixings bar allows you to customize how your burger is dressed.  My burger was hot, juicy and very flavorful.  The fries hot and crispy with perfect amount of salt. The restaurant is well maintained and there is plenty of seating. The staff is professional and courteous making sure to address any wants or needs during your dining experience
customer_insights: Fuddruckers in Norfolk is known for its great burgers and customizable toppings bar, making it a popular choice for families and casual dining. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the staff is attentive, contributing to a positive dining experience.

address: 1919 Monticello Ave, Norfolk, VA 23517, USA
googleReviews:
Nothing better than Doumar’s.
Got a couple of hot dogs with mustard and onions. I love how they chop the onions so fine. It’s not just good food, the service and atmosphere lend to the experience. When I drove by I almost didn’t stop because the place was so busy, the parking lot was almost full. I decided to take a chance, went inside to order takeout. Even though they were full, I only waited a couple of minutes to get my food. It is a madhouse in there with everybody doing their part, making drinks, making dessert, plating the food, and taking the food to the cars.  It’s exciting to see old fashion car hops with the trays that hang on the door.
Hot dogs are $2.40 each.

Always an amazing diner experience. Wife and I love the nostalgia. My wife's parents had went on their first date here @ Doumars. The hot dogs and burgers are yummy. We got the limited time Pumpkin Shake. The staff are very courteous.

Doumar’s in Norfolk is a true local treasure and one of my favorite places to eat in the entire Hampton Roads area. If you’re looking for comforting, old school diner food done right, this is the spot. The BBQ pork sandwich is a must try!!! tender, flavorful, and served with just the right amount of slaw to balance the smoky meat. Their burgers are simple but perfect, griddled to juicy perfection and stacked with classic toppings. The hot dogs have that satisfying snap, and the crinkle cut fries are always hot, crispy, and well seasoned.

And the milkshakes? Thick, creamy, and made just how they should be. I highly recommend the chocolate or strawberry, both are rich without being overpowering. Portions are generous, prices are more than fair, and everything comes out fast whether you eat inside or pull up at the drive-in.

It’s that kind of food that reminds you why the classics never go out of style. There’s nothing pretentious about Doumar’s, just great food served with care. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or sitting down for a full meal, this place never disappoints. I’ll keep coming back again and again. Five stars all the way.
Brings joy to my heart! Excellent service, good food, fair prices, creamy shakes.

My mom and I decided to go to Doumar’s for lunch. We have heard about Doumar’s for years, and today was our first time eating there. The cheeseburgers and fries were very good. The simplicity of the food is what makes it good. I ordered a Cherry Coke, and it was delicious since they make it themselves. The hot fudge cake was delicious as well. We will return to try some more of their eats and treats.
customer_insights: Doumar's Cones & Barbecue is a beloved local diner in Norfolk, known for its nostalgic atmosphere and classic American comfort food. Customers rave about the hot dogs, burgers, and thick milkshakes, highlighting the friendly service and quick turnaround, making it a perfect spot for a casual meal.

googleReviews: Food was excellent. I had the Chesapeake Benedict...so creative and yummy!! And the mimosa flight was refreshing on a hot day and the perfect way to try several flavors (since I couldn't make up my mind). Server and staff was very friendly and knowledgeable too!).

It was an alright experience. The potatoes were perfect and the carnivore omelette filled me up. I loved whatever soft cheese was inside of it. The presentation of the Benedict was also nice.

Things that turned me off: the coffee flight was bland and tasteless, the waffles were soft and didn’t seem fresh, and the mandatory 18% tip added to each check. I’d like to control how much I’d like to tip. The price is a bit on the high side but not terribly unreasonable considering the location. Otherwise it seemed like an okay place to go to but this might be a one time deal for me.
Nice spot for breakfast in downtown Norfolk. Portions were generous but not overwhelming. Good service and clean!

Great breakfast spot, with or without alcohol. We went right at opening and received friendly service and excellent food.

Do note that an 18% gratuity is added automatically, as it may not be obvious.

I dined here for breakfast and I had an amazing time! The food is truly amazing, the portion sizes are great, and the price is very reasonable! customer_insights: Hair of the Dog Eatery is a casual breakfast spot in Downtown Norfolk known for its friendly service and creative menu options. address: 2406 Colonial Ave, Norfolk, VA 23517, USA

Come here for happy hour or brunch! Perfect outdoor garden seating on a beautiful day. Very cool eclectic vibe.  Ginger beer needs to be sold in growlers or some sort of takeaway.  It is very good.  The mushroom gravy was delicious. I am picky about menus being explicit. This cute place has good food and decent prices. The French toast was on a brioche bread Which makes it better than most.  If you get there between seven and nine, they have an early bird meals for under $10! .
We went on a Sunday around 11.  We had to park across the street as there isn’t a lot of parking. The service Was good and the atmosphere was so cute.

I’ll definitely be back!

Came in on Thursday morning August 7th along with 3 friends of mine for breakfast/brunch. Be aware parking is very limited behind the restaurant, we were excited to come in from reading all of the good reviews online but did not have the same experience.
Walking in, we were not greeted and I looked around for a host/hostess, a woman sitting at the bar pauses and goes “just 4 of you” and seats us, no hello or welcome in. Our server brought us waters and said she would come back to take our order. 15 minutes had past and she had not yet taken our order while our minds were made up quickly, during this time we saw her seat other tables and take their orders first and other staff walked right past us seeing we still had our menus.
Finally someone came from the bar to take our order, the food was pretty good and fresh, the waffle is quite dense so if you want something light and fluffy try the pancakes instead.

customer_insights: Karla's Beach House offers a casual, beachy atmosphere with a focus on breakfast and brunch. While many reviews praise the food and friendly service, some customers have reported inconsistent service experiences. It is a great spot for a laid-back meal with friends or family.

address: 4408 Colley Ave, Norfolk, VA 23508, USA
googleReviews: I stumbled on this place through DoorDash. I decided to go in person and try it and BOY AM I GLAD I DID. This place is wonderful, I got the banana mocha (has alcohol) and it was delicious. For my breakfast I got the monte cristo and it was amazing. The avocado burrito was also ordered and it looked amazing. I was told it was so good. I’ll definitely be bringing my friends over here for breakfast. This place is nice and quiet. So wonderful!

I love the aesthetic of this place. Everyone is so polite and approachable. They have 2 dressing that I am currently obsessed with (lemon | lavender) both made in house. I go to spot for a nice vegan brunch. (Finding vegan option restaurant becomes a pain .. they have a good amount of vegan options)

I cannot say enough about this cute little spot. My family and I had called ahead to another restaurant a few doors down. We were a party of 11 on Oct 19, and we were told we could be accommodated but they don't take reservations. Upon arriving there, that was not the case. We were not able to be sat and so we needed to find another place to eat. I was standing on the sidewalk and looking in my phone for other places and happened to notice some bright pink. I saw that is was a restaurant and walked over to see if they could help us. I first apologized for even showing up with 11 people without calling a head or making a reservation. I have been in the service industry in many different roles over the years, and would never! I explained what happened down the street and asked if there was any way they could help us. I totally understood if not. The very sweet lady who helped said they actually have a covered porch area in the back that was not being used if we were open to it, and if we would just be patient with them as they were full. We were happy to take them up and glad we did. We had a guy that was our server and he was great. We immediately got drinks. He continued to ask for our patience but it was no problem at all. We were so happy not to have to drive around or call looking for a place. He was wonderful. The FOOD was SO GOOD!. I have celiac disease and must be gluten free. They had a lot of options for me. The drinks were amazing the food was amazing and the service was top notch!! If you get a chance stop in and give them a try!! As for me, I'll definitely be back! Thanks again for not making us feel terrible and making room for our crew!!

They have a few vegan options. The vegan burrito was pretty good. Once I added the local hot sauce it became a great burrito. The fruit cup was a fresh combination of pineapple, strawberries, and blueberries. Give them a try!

The music was good, too.

address: 429 Granby St, Norfolk, VA 23510, USA
googleReviews: The service was excellent, but the food wasn't great (although it looked great). I ordered the Bread & Butter, the Oyster Mushrooms, and the Burger. The Bread and Butter was delicious. However, the oyster mushrooms tasted fishy which was off putting. I had high hopes for the Burger after reading other reviews online but it was underwhelming to say the least. The meat was not good and tasted overworked. What's really annoying is they add a 20% gratuity to the bill without saying anything, and I didn't notice until wrote in the tip for 20% and noticed the text at the bottom. So I ended up tipping 40% instead of my usual 20% which I do even if the food is bad. The service was really good so I just let it be but that's so unheard of, especially for one person. I get adding a fixed gratuity on a check for 5+ people but that's the only time it makes sense. It's also worth mentioning that the restaurant is just generally uncomfortable. The seats are wood and it's all one room so it's loud. Overall it wasn't a good experience.

My wife and I went here first time this past Friday evening. Small, intimate place. Service was top notch. Drinks and beer was excellent. The food? I cannot stop talking about how good it was. I had the Pork Shoulder. My wife had the Burger. The appetizer was Pimento with everything crackers. Like massive tortilla chips baked. Mmm.

There was definitely a chef in the kitchen.

We had such a wonderful dining experience. We opted for the 3 course pasta Tuesday night special. I had lemon drop martini. Best ever! Dinner was Cesar salad the cheese was so delicious. However the croutons stoled the show.lol. Dinner was a beef Bolognese. Hit the spot. Dessert was a Bananna chocolate chip cookie with homemade caramel sauce . Delicious. I do feel like the ice cream portion was off . However the combo was superb. The best waitress served everyone with enthusiasm and kindness! Adored her.

Upon walking in, it was packed so first impressions is the food must be good. I didn't have a reservation but it was seating available at the bar like table facing the garage style door for 2. I tried briefly before arriving to find menu on the IG page, I didn't see one.  I ordered the pineapple ginger mock tail as they have a set non alcoholic menu. My friend order same meal and 2 cocktail as pictured. The bread and butter is an appetizer it was actually really good. Food got the beef ribs, with grits, and potatoes asked to whole the carrots. You can omit an item but no substitutions. The rib was juicy and tender the grits paired well with rib, but the potatoes are undercooked. The service from entire staff was great, very attentive. I came, I tried but not the place for a return for me.

Top notch food and service! Everything delicious and well-executed, maybe a little expensive for what it is, but price aside a wonderful meal and experience. Peach and burrata perfectly complemented by pickled shallot, balsamela, and bread crumbs. House baked focaccia with whipped butter and just the right amount of salt is fantastic. Thai peanut salad is outstanding, dressing is particularly wonderful. Nduja flavorful and unique, especially over perfectly-toasted sourdough. Prosciutto and onion tart another exquisite amalgamation of complementary flavors, certainly not too blue-cheesy if that's a concern like it sometimes is for us. Brussels perfectly crispy and savory with accompanying crushed peanuts and nuoc cham. Cauliflower a canvas for a balanced combination of robust, yet not overpowering, spices and flavors. Potato pancake was just a touch bland, the only source of disappointment with the food. Burger and Fett are must-try house specialties, both bursting with savory flavor and expertly-prepared. All three desserts are great options depending on your preference, especially decadent toffee pudding with perfect whipped cream and salted toffee sauce. Drinks were slightly disappointing, seemed like a small amount for the price point, with a neat but voluminous rectangular prism ice cube taking up so much of some of the glasses. Coffee Spritz, Algonquin, and Downtown Revival cocktails are all well-crafted, unique and carefully balanced with lots of flavors that work well together, each subtly present and not overpowering the others. Old Town Cider was a fun try, a bit on the sweeter side, but certainly not too much so. After Dinner Flight another fun try. Service very attentive, relaxed atmosphere, bathrooms clean. 20% tip is included on the bill, and they certainly don't try to sneak this by you as some have claimed, they bring it right to your attention. Excellent experience all around, definitely recommend!

Finally made it in for brunch - food just as outstanding as their dinner menu! Chocolate chip French toast very nice, thick and rich with tasty embedded chocolate chips. Best quiche we've ever had - outstanding savory and thick crust, caramelized onions and gouda baked in, and accompanying smoked tomato cream sauce! Very nice sides of sausage and bacon, and vanilla and cinnamon cardamom vanilla lattes were both flavorful and excellent. Raspberry jam glazed donut focaccia an awesome and unique sweet treat! Very busy for brunch, and no brunch reservations, so definitely plan on either a long wait or getting there before they open at 10 to wait in line and snag an early table, maybe even 9:30-9:45. We got there at 9:50 and were lucky to get one of the last remaining tables before they all filled up. Service accordingly  somewhat slow considering they fill right up at 10 AM, understandable of course.
customer_insights: Codex offers an upscale dining experience with a focus on Italian and Mediterranean cuisine. The ambiance is intimate and trendy, making it suitable for various occasions, including dates and celebrations.

address: 450 Court St, Portsmouth, VA 23704, USA
googleReviews: Chef's kiss because everything was delicious and the experience was top notched. My husband and I had an amazing date night at Still. We enjoyed the atmosphere,  service and food. I can't wait to go back.
food, atmosphere and service was amazing.  Will definitely be coming back.   and they have one of the best bourbon selections i have seen in a while.

Great night cap for any occasion. Didn't have any food on this first trip, but the huge kitchen smell so good! Enjoyed the rum Boom Boom.
Remember, not a full kitchen. Small plates and fun stuff.

address: 742 W 21st St, Norfolk, VA 23517, USA
googleReviews: There are a lot of Pho and Ramen joints around.  Alkaline is different. Namely the meat in the soups are prepared with a care and process quickly noticeable as next level good. I had the Triple Garlic Tonkatsu Ramen and a side of Fried Rice. As someone who has lived in Japan for three years and meticulously documented food experiences globally, I found this meal extremely disappointing. Regrettably, this was the worst ramen I have ever encountered.
Core Problems:
* Ramen Broth: The broth was noticeably tasteless. Despite its thick, creamy texture, it lacked any discernible flavor, tasting like over-concentrated water rather than a rich stock.
* Off-Flavors: The fried rice, the eggs, and the pickled ginger all shared a strong, unpleasant chemical flavor. The rice was also excessively crunchy, and the ginger was nothing like the spiced Japanese variety.
* Condiment Error: A request for chili oil was met with an unexpected mix of oil, vinegar, and fried garlic, which was not suitable for the dish.
Highlights & Scope:
The Tonkatsu was the sole positive, being thoroughly cooked and juicy. Note that the fried pork belly is extremely rich and best ordered in small amounts.

My critique is limited to the Triple Garlic  Tonkatsu ramen and fried rice. I know from other local spots that menus items can vary and that sometimes the flavor changes depending on the day, but these core items were a complete miss due to fundamental flavor issues.

I can't say much for the atmosphere seeing that I went during the day right after opening.

I've been to Alkaline three times now --- the first time was for a meet and greet I scheduled for a group that I run. I met some great people for a brainstorming session and forgot to leave a good word...but Alkaline is a great restaurant with a really cool atmosphere that is especially appealing if you are into anime and/or manga. There is artwork that reminds me of some of the more traditional Japanese restaurants that I've been to, but also things from Fullmetal Alchemist, among other things. To add, the staff is friendly and gave some good info when we asked a couple of questions about the food we were curious about.

The ramen was very tasty, and the bowls are rather large (or so I feel). I got the Tonkotsu Ramen and my partner got the Smokehouse Ramen. We tried each other's dishes and liked everything, but what I REALLY wanna talk about is the "Miso Butter Cake"...I have not encountered such a cake at the restaurants I've been to before. If someone was serving it, I was not aware...but the Miso Butter Cake at Alkaline is seriously one of THE best cakes I have EVER had. I STRONGLY recommend it, especially with the scoop of ice cream. The cake is warm and melts in the mouth, but it's also buttery and creamy, and the pecans and the flaky crust of the cake (near the back of the cake) --- all of those things go so well together, in my opinion. It was deceptively filling as well, but it could be because me and my partner already had shared an appetizer and had our own large bowls of ramen, prior to tackling the cake. So, sharing the cake was perfect for us.

If you try nothing else, definitely try the Miso Butter Cake!
customer_insights: Alkaline offers a unique dining experience with a focus on high-quality ramen and a vibrant atmosphere influenced by anime culture. Do yourself a favor and find better barbecue where you will be appreciated as a customer, do not eat here. He is a negative owner producing negative product. From one of his biggest but certainly one of his last supporters. Never eat in a place that you aren’t welcome to dine in. They’re not trustworthy.

Had 1/2 rack ribs and the pulled pork sandwich special with bacon and cheese fries. Ribs were tender with an excellent BBQ sauce. You can definitely taste the hickory in the meat. Service was great, place was clean and good was great. Defenitly will stop in again. Great prices for the portions you get. I couldn't eat all of my ribs and had to take some home .
budget_friendly_items: BBQ sandwich special with one side and drink for $12
customer_insights: Johnson's BBQ is a casual, family-owned spot known for its fantastic BBQ and friendly service. While the food receives high praise for its flavor and value, some customers have reported inconsistent service experiences, particularly with the owner. It's a great place for a laid-back meal, especially for BBQ lovers.

address: 114 Madison Ave, Norfolk, NE 68701, USA
googleReviews: Service was friendly and fast.  The brisket taste great but, it was a bit dry for my liking.  The pork, chicken and ribs were delicious. The smoked beans were a bit on the pepper side. Overall it was a good meal. I had the Dream Platter.

Some items were better than others.  The beans were very good, the brisket sandwich was good, and so was the potato salad.  Not really a bang for your buck place, but I'm willing to try it a second time.

I ordered catering for a business lunch and the food was amazing. We had a variety of sides and meats, everything was so juicy and flavorful! The brisket was so tender that it fell apart when serving, the ribs were perfect and the mac and cheese was simple yet so good.

One of my favorites. When friends or family come to visit this is one of the first places I suggest to try. The staff has always been great and the BBQ is fantastic. Just had the Wednesday special, a brisket burrito with chili and queso...  it was so good I debated coming back later that day to get it for supper as well. Truly one of my favorite places in town.

Visiting from out of town so we ordered take out. Meat was smoked but had no flavor, the potato salad and macaroni salad all lacked any seasoning , even the BBQ sauce didn't taste like BBQ sauce. So I can not give any real good comments about this place.
customer_insights: Smokin Stan's BBQ in Norfolk is a casual dining spot known for its friendly service and a variety of smoked meats. While many customers rave about the brisket and ribs, some have noted inconsistencies in flavor, particularly with the brisket. Overall, it's a solid choice for BBQ lovers looking for a laid-back meal.

address: 1901 E Ocean View Ave, Norfolk, VA 23503, USA
googleReviews: I wish they had chicken wings on the menu full time. They were very good! The brisket was dry and the pulled pork was pretty fatty. The cornbread was almost wet. They were out of ribs by 1pm when we got there which was half the reason we drove so far for. Fries were good but had to get those and the wings from outside. It was decent experience. Building was clean, people were nice.

Edit 2025: I used to enjoy this place, went there recently 2 meat plater was $28, for one rib and a tiny piece of brisket, pictured below. Two sides, they gave me beans instead of the Mac I asked for. Half pound of pork belly was $15.50 for 5 small quarter inch slices. I know meat isn't cheap, but unfortunately there are better places with better prices.

Went two weeks later. Waited in line only to be told the special menu they had on a board at the head of the line had been sold out for a while(why wouldnt they remove it). Guy behind the counter couldn't tell me what the desserts were in the case next to him, just said idk, some kinda brownie. I hope people have better experience when they move, but I would not recommend this place to ANYONE. If I could give less than 1 star I would.

Original post: Probably the top 2 bbq joints I've had in Virginia. I highly recommend it. It's also combined with a brewery which is cool since you can order beers (separate counter) everything there is good but I highly recommend their pork belly! Their mac n cheese and potato salad are great too!

If I could give this place a 20/10 I would. I would love to give a special shout out to Andrew and MaeMae (if I'm wrong, charge it to my heart) but those two went out of there way to properly serve my brisket since I do not eat pork. The consideration for your customers warmed my heart and pinned this restaurant to my top 10! The brisket was tender as can be and someone must have put their foot in the mac and cheese cause GOSHOMIGHTY was that thang good. I'm reminiscing all over again. We had two of the brownies to go home with and that was the little piece of bar-q that we were able to take home. Such a delicious sweet treat. Hat's off to this place. I'll be back with my parents to show them this new staple of OV. Much Love you guys 💗

After nine months deployed I needed some good bbq.  This place did not disappoint.  Brisket, spareribs, and link were perfectly cooked and the flavors were amazing.  Side bbq was absolutely delicious.  Mac and cheese exactly how I like it.  Slaw was great.  Also got the lemonade which was refreshing and not too sweet.

I have mixed feelings about this place. The sides were amazing, I would come back only for the sides. However, the barbecue left much to be desired. The pork belly was tough and dry, some of the brisket was dry, and some not, and the rib was moist on one side and dry on the other. The seasoning wasn't bad, but definitely needed the sauce to carry it. I'm glad I ordered the sides, because the meat was not enough to fill me, but that because I couldn't order alot due to the high cost per pound. Total price was $38, so for that price point, I should have gone elsewhere and gotten more. I know that the costs of labor and product have gone up, but these are tourist prices for being on the beach. There are plenty of great barbecue spots in the area where the prices are fair.
customer_insights: Bar-Q offers a mix of experiences with its BBQ offerings, receiving mixed reviews on food quality and portion sizes. While the sides are generally praised, the meat dishes have been criticized for inconsistency in preparation and value for money.

address: 2718 Granby St, Norfolk, VA 23510, USA
googleReviews:
first time I was able to go in while they were open and I was awake!

first off, wonderful atmosphere. good music, vibes were on point. I was greeted instantly, and given help after I said I hadn't been there before. I placed an order for the sausage combo, I got the fries and a bottle water for my drink. the whole order was made to order, fries too! fresh fries, a slamming link in a pretzel bun w ketchup mustard and fried onions.

as I was leaving, I was offered a sample of a wrap, didn't get the name of it and I wish I did bc one bite of the sample and I said out loud "oh gods that's good" and then shoved the rest of the sample in my mouth to enjoy as I walked back to my car.

the sign in the chips made me laugh and was a good tip for each day! "May I be as happy as a bird with a fry" and that is a simple joy I do wish to have and others to have. and they sure accomplished it! I was very happy with my order, I ate it so fast! I will absolutely be going back!

I love this little vegan spot. The camaraderie is unmatched. Also a cute pet lizard you can pet if you like. Cute trinkets and herbs and best of all Chef Deena makes the best food all filled with love. This spot is my new go to hole in the wall café. Try the Mediterranean wrap!
I was happy to find a 100% Vegan place in the area before my flight home to Orlando. My son and I loved it. The burger was amazing and so were the cauliflower wings. The rasta mac and cheese was 🔥

Vegan Planet Café is that spot! I’ve spent over $500 here in just the past two days, and it was worth every penny. The cauliflower wings are incredible, the chicken sandwiches are on point, and don’t even get me started on the banana pudding — me and my brother came through and grabbed the last two!

I came back the very next day with my uncle, and once again, it was a big order and an even better experience. The atmosphere is fantastic — live music, good vibes, and the most welcoming people. Special shoutout to Mrs. Dee and E — y’all make the place feel like home.

I’ll definitely be back at least once a week. Vegan Planet Café is a solid 10 out of 10 in every way! 🌱🔥

Very welcoming and friendly. Wasn’t afraid to speak and allow you to walk around in peace.
Food was flavorful and it hit the spot! Sea moss drink was not bad either.
Should try it!!!
customer_insights: Vegan Planet Cafe is a vibrant and welcoming spot known for its delicious vegan comfort food and friendly atmosphere. Customers rave about the quality of the food, particularly the cauliflower wings and various wraps, making it a popular choice for both casual dining and social gatherings.

address: 615 High St, Portsmouth, VA 23704, USA
googleReviews: This place is fantastic—amazing food and exceptional service! You can really tell the food is made with love; everything was fresh and absolutely delicious. We tried the waffle sandwich, vegan Philly, and the grilled vegan wrap—each one was full of flavor and perfectly prepared. Our server, who I’m guessing also cooked the food, was so sweet and welcoming. Highly recommend!

Pick this gem for first date and left in Love with the food and atmosphere! Had the place pretty much to ourselves as there was a community parade and event going on outside on the street. Had a wonderful ginger wellness drink, avocado sea moss salad and mushroom sandwich (mlt) 🔥 🙌🏻 I find it so hard to find a vegan restaurant that I really enjoy but this place blew my mind! The food was fresh and so yummy! I will most definitely be back! No photos of the food as it was all devoured 🩷

I love beyond vegan. I love the lions mane sandwich but as of late I’ve been getting the soups. Great on a cold day. My favorite is the navy bean soup but you can’t go wrong with the mushroom or gumbo. Today i got the gumbo soup with an avocado sea moss salad. Both were delicious.

Finally, I found a restaurant with healthy choices, a friendly environment, and, most importantly, the food was tasty! I ordered the vegan cheesesteak egg rolls, Royal Flush fresh juice, fries and a side salad. The salad dressing was delicious, as well as the egg rolls. I ordered the mushroom soup, and vegan gumbo to go so my family can try it, and they loved it.

Initially, the service at the bar was slow, but they took good care of me. I am calling tomorrow to order a gallon of Royal Flush juice for the week. Thank you for bringing healthy alkaline choices to our community!

I contemplated several times rather I was going to leave a review or not. After carefully thinking about the type of review that I wanted to leave, I wanted my review to come from a good place versus what I experienced as a customer that visited Beyond Vegan place of business for the first time. Which took place on October 25, 2025.

The lack of professionalism was not present! Upon placing my order, With having a food allergy to tomatoes, the gentleman that took my order, I distinctively told him that I didn't want tomatoes and for all sauces is to be placed on the side. Even though I didn't have too, I explain to the guy that I was traveling back to North Carolina and I didn't want my sandwich or anything else to be wet and soggy from the sauce. In response, the guy stated that I was trying to make his job harder because he had to remove the tomatoes individually from each item that I ordered that came with tomatoes. He sarcastically stated that I'm the customer, like Burger King, "You can have it your way." Remind you this is my first time visiting Beyond Vegan. I asked what side options come with my order and I was told only the salad. I was also told that if I wanted additional sides that it was going to cost me extra. I placed my order and drink order for the blue vervain tea I stated no ice. I was told that it was hot tea not cold.
•	Place my order, had the guy to repeat back to me my entire order so that I could make sure that it was correct. Paid for everything and even left a $4 tip for a TO GO order.
•	Waited 20 to 30 minutes.
•	Received my order with no drink.
I informed the lady, which I am going to assume is the owner, that I didn't receive my drink. I waited an additional 5 minutes for the "Hot Tea."

I checked my food prior to driving off. The tea was cold. Which is unacceptable! That's why I stayed and waited for an additional 5 extra minutes on top of the 30 minutes that I had already been waiting. Tomatoes were on 2 of the sandwiches as well as the salads that came with each order. I am/was VERY DISAPPOINTED and slightly irritated by the unprofessionalism. Beyond Vegan totally disregard me not wanting tomatoes, I now wasted my time and money because I could have went somewhere else. After looking at multiple reviews, this deeply saddens me because I didn't receive the quality service based off of the recommendations of 2 business owners, as well as several reviews on Google for Beyond Vegan that I read prior to going to the restaurant.

I took my food back inside to make Beyond Vegan aware of the tomatoes that were placed on both sandwiches and each salad and the tea was not hot. I mentioned to the owner that I do not eat bread that came with one of the orders. The lady that I spoke with stated, "unless Dr. Sebi himself walks through that door and tells me anything different. I'm still going to use this bread. Her statement had nothing to do with me or my order. I apologized if I read the order description wrong. She then showed me from her phone what type of bread it was. Sara Lee Artesano brioche style bread. Which is not gluten-free! NOT once was I given an option of a wrap or the chickpea waffle bread. I didn't want to make a big deal over the bread or anything else so I kept partial of my order (Lion's Mane Nuggets & Lion's Mane Chicken Breast (Mushroom), in which I had to take the tomatoes off of the Lion's Mane Chicken Breast (Mushroom) sandwich & the salad.  I asked for my money back for the drink and Be Vegan VBLT (King Oyster Mushrooms).

I'm sure Beyond Vegan is a great place to eat. Maybe it's safe to say that I came on the wrong day. Communication and professionalism in food service is a MUST, in order for a business to thrive! Words of wisdom: In order to have compassion and love for what you do, has to be received by the customer in order to receive compassion and love back to the business owner!
customer_insights: Beyond Vegan Cell Food is praised for its fresh, flavorful vegan dishes and welcoming atmosphere, making it a great spot for casual dining and first dates. However, there are mixed reviews regarding service quality, with some customers experiencing issues with food preparation and staff professionalism.

address: 5660 Indian River Rd #110, Virginia Beach, VA 23464, USA
googleReviews:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 Stars – A Hidden Gem That’ll Win Your Heart and Your Taste Buds!
If you haven’t been to JMT Vegan Eats at 5660 Indian River Rd Suite 110 in Virginia Beach yet you are truly missing out on something special. The moment you step inside you can feel the warmth not just from the kitchen but from the people. The staff greet you like family the space feels bright and cozy and there’s this undeniable sense of care that fills the air. It’s the kind of place where you can unwind, laugh, and just enjoy good food made with real love. I decided to go all in and ordered two milkshakes the Vanilla and the Oreo and let me tell you they were nothing short of amazing. The vanilla shake was creamy, smooth, and perfectly sweet like the kind of milkshake you dream about on a hot day. But the Oreo shake pure heaven. Thick, rich, and packed with that perfect cookies and cream crunch. It was indulgent in the best way possible and the fact that it’s completely vegan blew my mind. You don’t miss dairy here you forget it ever existed. Then came the Philly Vegan Steak and honestly I still can’t stop thinking about it. The steak was tender and flavorful with perfectly sautéed peppers and onions that gave every bite the ideal mix of sweetness and spice. The texture was so spot on, you’d swear you were eating the real thing only lighter and more satisfying. It’s comfort food with a conscience and it’s absolutely delicious. Next up was the burger and wow JMT really knows how to do it right. The patty was juicy and flavorful cooked to perfection and paired with crisp lettuce, fresh tomato, and a soft, slightly toasted bun. Every bite was balanced messy in the best kind of way and bursting with flavor. It’s the kind of burger that makes you pause mid meal just to appreciate how good it is. You can tell the chef puts heart into every single plate that leaves that kitchen. For dessert, I tried both the cupcakes and a strawberry sprinkle doughnut, and they were pure happiness in dessert form. The cupcakes were moist, fluffy, and topped with silky frosting that melted in your mouth. Then the doughnut soft, sweet, and topped with pink icing and colorful sprinkles was like a burst of nostalgia and joy all at once. You could tell each treat was made with care and love the kind of desserts that make you smile with every bite. Overall, JMT Vegan Eats is more than just a restaurant it’s an experience. The food is phenomenal, the service is full of heart, and the atmosphere makes you feel like you belong there. Every dish from the shakes to the Philly steak, the burgers to the sweets, tells a story of passion and purpose. Whether you’re vegan, vegetarian, or simply a fan of incredible food, you’ll leave JMT Vegan Eats not just full, but genuinely happy. It’s the kind of place you’ll think about long after you’ve left and you’ll already be planning your next visit before you even walk out the door. Trust me once you go, you’ll be counting the days until you can go back.

I cannot say enough good things! From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel right at home—so friendly, welcoming, and genuinely passionate about what they do.

Everything we ordered was fantastic. The seasoned fries were crispy and full of flavor—seriously amazing. We tried both the cheesesteaks (season chicken &  jerk steak), and they were so good—savory, satisfying, and packed with bold, delicious spices. The jerk had a spicy kick that was just right. The milkshakes were the perfect ending—creamy, smooth, and totally hit the spot without any dairy.

It’s always special to support a place where you can feel the heart behind the food. If you’re in the area—vegan or not—this spot is a must-visit!

I absolutely love this place. My husband and I just started our vegan journey and decided to give JMT Vegan Eats a try. We got turned around and arrived very late-- just a few minutes before they closed. Not only did they stay open late to accommodate us, but they were incredibly kind and welcoming. This is a family-run business, primarily managed by their amazing children, who won a youth Shark Tank contest for their vegan ice cream. The parents kept us company while their teen/young adult kids prepared the most amazing vegan sandwiches we have ever tasted. I had the burger, and my husband had the Philly Cheese steak. We were practically licking our fingers after our meal. :-) Even before switching to a vegan diet, I had long given up cheese due to lactose intolerance. But since their cheese is, of course, dairy-free, I decided to indulge. I am not sure what they put in that cheese sauce, but it was amazing.

I highly recommend this for anyone who just likes good food. Honestly, you would not know the food was vegan.  It's also great for people who can't have dairy but still want to enjoy all the yummy goodness of ice cream, shakes, and more. My husband has a severe shellfish allergy, so we can't wait to try their vegan crab cakes. Please give them a try and bring your friends. You will not be disappointed!

UNBELIEVABLE!!
Customer Service  10
Food 10
Cleanliness 10
When I say the customer service was better than Chick-fil-A. The food taste better than regular food, it's the BEST vegan food that I've ever had. I give them 10's across the board. If you're not vegan, go any way you will not be disappointed!!

THE FOOD AND ATMOSPHERE WAS AMAZING! It was the best breakfast for me as vegetarian, in whole country. Even my meat-eating husband was full and satisfied for this meal. Service was amazing, very kind, and welcoming. It was my first visit in this restaurant and definitely not the last one.
customer_insights: JMT Vegan Eats is a beloved local spot known for its warm atmosphere and exceptional vegan comfort food. Customers rave about the quality of the dishes, which cater to both vegans and non-vegans alike, making it a great choice for anyone looking for delicious, plant-based meals.

address: 1270 Diamond Springs Rd #102, Virginia Beach, VA 23455, USA
googleReviews: Happy Café is simply delightful. The atmosphere is elegant yet warmly nostalgic — it feels like a refined version of your grandmother’s home. Every detail exudes charm and comfort. And the food… truly spectacular! Each dish is crafted with care and impeccable taste. I couldn’t recommend it more highly.

Oh my goodness! What a brunch! What an ATMOSPHERE! I googled restaurants near me and decided to try the Happy Café because it had the best reviews (and I can see why!). We went on a packed Sunday (Nov 9, 2025), and we were greeted warmly! Comfortable Chic chairs were available while we waited. The staff checked in often while we waited and offered water. They were so attentive even before we sat down! The owner Tamika (hope I spelled her name right) personally checked in to make sure we were seated in a timely manner! Her mother Mrs. V came to talk to us often during her shift to check in on the food. And the waitress Marisa was PHENOMENAL! The food came out PIPING hot, and within 2-10 minutes of ordering. We were so shocked at the speed. I had the Burgundy black tea and never have i had tea so flavorful! (And it wasn't a tea bag, they were loose leaves steeped in your own tea pot! Amazing!). The grits in the shrimp and grits were SO creamy, the cajun sauce on it (same sauce as what's on the grilled corn) was to die for! SO SEASONED  and creamy! Omg. The blueberry pancakes are a MUST. Everything was just perfect. Made more perfect by the professional but warm staff! It felt like family! Mrs. V even gave me and my son a hug and it felt like I was leaving grandma's house! I didn't want to leave. I'm so exited to have found this GEN. I can't wait until next payday to come back!

P.S. -Do NOT leave without getting the bread pudding! It's smothered in a thick caramel sauce that cannot be passed up! Omg. This place. So amazing!!!!!!

Breakfast: A good idea- the menus were on the table so I could study up on my order as soon as I sat down. The waitress brought water and a big cup of flavorful coffee and soon took my order.

it’s difficult to get eggs over medium cooked right. Mine were perfect. Good sausage patties, excellent buttered wheat toast.

Nice instrumental jazz background music. And a BIG consideration these days - the place was not too loud and has a nice front lounge to await a carryout order.

They even have a hot tea menu that I’ll be sure to try next time. I’ll be back

Byrd was an amazing server and so sweet! From the outside this place might not look like much but as soon as you enter through those doors, the beautiful decor and relaxing atmosphere brings you in. When you enter, there is a to go, but the magic is where the restaurant and the bar is on the other side. I had a simple eggs and bacon with toast. I loved their tea. I had Lavender lemon tea highly recommend if you go! Overall, a great experience I will definitely be returning.

Found this gem on Yelp when we landed at the airport hungry. OUTSTANDING food! We all 4 cleared our plates. Gorgeous atmosphere. Super friendly staff. We had the Cafe Roast, The Italian, Club Sandwich, Beef Tower, fries and OMG the delicious mac-n-cheese! 100% recommend this great place and we will definitely come back!
customer_insights: Happy Cafe offers a warm and inviting atmosphere reminiscent of a grandmother's home, making it a perfect spot for brunch or family gatherings. The attentive staff and quick service enhance the dining experience, while the delicious food, including standout items like shrimp and grits and blueberry pancakes, leave patrons eager to return.

address: 1434 Sam's Dr #102, Chesapeake, VA 23320, USA
googleReviews: Service was exceptional. We were there after lunch rush so we easily seated. Prices were reasonable. I had the Vegan Blackened Chicken Pita. It was tender with just the right amount of heat. Nestled in a fresh pita with garden greens, mango and a wonderful aioli drizzle. From this omnivore who enjoys plant based foods.... simply delicious. The side of sweet potato fries were fabulous! And the chickpea soup my mom ordered was so special I ordered a bowl to go (they prepared it to be ready just as we finished meal). If I lived in the area (medical visit nearby), they would know me by name. From the chatter at the other tables it was clear that this establishment is a go-to for flat out good food. Love this place. Looking forward to making it a point to return!
Great atmosphere and service. We were greeted promptly and our food came out fast. Pictured is the avocado club with sweet potato fries. It was pretty good!

This place has great healthy options for affordable prices, which has been hard to find in this area IMO. The mango salmon salad was great and had a nice citrus kick to it with the mango and the dressing. I highly recommend trying this place out if you haven’t yet!

This is the most revolting restaurant I have ever stepped foot in. After we ordered our food we sat down then noticed every vent on the ceiling was covered in mold and dust clumps. It was absolutely disgusting and every vent looks like this. One of the vents had a walnut sized clump of dust hanging from it. We ended up getting our food to go then just throwing it away. I would never eat at an establishment that is this dirty.

This place was awesome! Excellent vegan menu options! I loved the fresh quality and homemade sauces. The flavors after a much adored taste. The staff were so kind, and we even got to meet the master minds behind these wonderfully succulent recipes! Yes! The food here is great for vegans and non-vegans. I wish they were open for longer hours, but I'll catch them when I can and visit often! This place reminded me of a restaurant in Philly as far as atmosphere and quality! I loved that!
customer_insights: The Cutting Edge Cafe is praised for its exceptional service and healthy, affordable menu options, particularly appealing to both vegans and omnivores. However, there are concerns regarding cleanliness that could impact the dining experience.

address: 219 Granby St, Norfolk, VA 23510, USA
googleReviews: This is such a beautiful restaurant and lovely for a first date. We enjoyed the deviled eggs, charcuterie, salmon, and cesar salad. My only feedback is the deviled eggs had WAY too much mustard, almost inedible. Besides this everything was delectable. Dave provided excellent customer service and cannot wait to be back and see him again!

We picked this restaurant based on the fact that it was the closest cover from the rain, and boy am I glad that nature convened. Everyone was incredibly friendly, the service was Johnny on the spot, and most importantly, the food was out of this world.

We had the bacon wrapped goat cheese stuffed figs with a blackberry sauce on top. I would go back just for this item alone. We also tried the druck confit on crostini with gorgonzola (?) and it was tasty as well.

For dinner we tried the beef spare ribs, the drunk duck burger, and the steak au poivre (forgive my spelling if incorrect). Every last detail was delicious. My kid had an off the wall request for an unlisted item, and they accommodated him without batting an eye.

I can't remember our servers name but she was delightful as well. The atmosphere is very nice where you could easily come dolled up for a special anniversary or birthday, but we rolled in with jeans and hoodies and felt right at home as well.

I literally can't say enough good things about this place, will definitely revisit.

I was there last Christmas and it was truly a gem! The staff were warm and attentive, which made the experience even better. We started with the gnocchi for appetizers — it was so good I wanted to order another plate! For our entrees, we had the grilled salmon and the filet au poivre. Both were cooked perfectly and tasted fantastic. I also tried their red sangria. While it was good, the cinnamon bark was a bit overpowering for my taste. Overall, a wonderful dining experience.

Wonderful wonderful place!!! The bar space is great! The outdoor space is small and quaint. Nice open seating area. The staff is courteous and accommodating. Cocktails are fun, food is amazing!! Definitely be back to enjoy this spot on Granby.

After leaving a reservation at another place due to poor & slow service, we were advised to try 219 Bistro. We were on a time crunch headed to a show at Chrysler Hall. We were provided a table outside immediately. Then we noticed we had been forgotten about outside! After asking another server about one for our table, Jerry the manager saved the day! He came out and apologized and offered a cocktail on the house (great lemon drops by the way). He came back with our drinks and took our order as well. He was very apologetic and accommodating- we really appreciated it. He brought over our server to introduce and she was apologetic and kind too. My friend got the duck burger and I had the grilled salmon and subbed for the brussels sprouts (I highly suggest the combo). The food was smashingly good. When we asked for our checks, Jerry advised that our meals were on the house and it was the least he could do. We were floored! Such a grand gesture. We weren't upset and didn't raise a fuss- that must have been appreciated! We thank you Jerry and will def return. You have big fans on the peninsula!
customer_insights: 219 Bistro is praised for its upscale atmosphere and attentive service, making it an excellent choice for special occasions like first dates and anniversaries. The menu features a variety of delicious dishes, and the staff is known for their accommodating nature, enhancing the overall dining experience.

address: 225 Granby St, Norfolk, VA 23510, USA
googleReviews: BEST baklava ever. I’ve been coming here for almost a decade for my baklava and I’ve tried it all over the US and never had a better baklava. The kindest man with the purest soul. Please come shop!! He has everything for great prices, and leave a tip;)

Made a stop at this deli spot because I wanted lunch and dinner options without going to different places.

Ran by a kind older gentleman, this spot has hot food as well as cold deli subs and more.

If you want to pack a lunch or dinner for later, a variety of bowls and entrees are available.

I enjoyed my turkey sub…I just wish I had a bit more oil (or whatever great tasting sauce he put on it) to make it less dry.

I look forward to trying the hot food another day.
Stopped in and grabbed a drink and some Baklava! I have to say I have very, very good!!! Been a long time since ive had Real Baklava! I plan on coming back for more!

Love GB&D!! It has continued to keep pace with whatever the economy, downtown, COVID throws at us!! The prepared food is great, the cooked meals are so good...LOVED MY SAUSAGE, EGG & CHEESE this AM - THANKS TONY!! And their FRIED FISH & CHICKEN is delicious! It's also a micro grocery store with many of the RIGHT things stocked!

HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

We had a great experience in this establishment. It struck us as more of a deli or bodega versus a bistro. We got some delicious hummus and pita, a cannoli, and a bottle of wine. Our food was great, but the real standout was the service. The gentleman Adel,  who was working--presumably the owner--was gracious, friendly, and didn't rush us even though we walked in right before closing. I would patronize this business any time and recommend it to others in the area.
customer_insights: Granby Bistro & Deli is a beloved local spot known for its delicious baklava and friendly service. address: The Gunton Arms, Norwich NR11 8TZ, UK
googleReviews: Fabulous place. If you're looking for a romantic break or a break with friends this is the place. So cozy so atmospheric. Food outstanding. The chef cooks the meat on a open fire to absolute perfection every time. Staff super friendly. Rooms fantastic. Thanks for a great break.

Having recently moved to the area we noticed that this place keeps winning awards so thought it worth a visit to see why.

The service was attentive and friendly throughout and the food… just amazing.  An interesting menu with something for everyone, delicious food, cooked with love and so well-presented.

We’ll be back!

They didn’t offer to take our drinks and there wasn’t a table available!! We were a bit cold because we weren’t in a room with a lit fire and the seating is very uncomfortable. Cushions on the hard wooden seats are desperately needed!! Noted poor outside lighting.

You park in a very large car park and enter the grounds of Gunton House via a steel gate. About 100m ahead is the Gunton Arms. As we approached the pub we could see a herd of deer, some with large set of antlers. Not your everyday pub this.
Warm greeting and taken through to our table. This is a dog friendly place and we had taken our cocker spaniel with us to enjoy our anniversary meal.
The food was very tasty.
We were in a back area where there is less light. At times it was a little dark for us, we are in our late 60s, the table candle not quite bright enough. Very romantic as it was.
We had said it was our anniversary and they left a card for us wishing us all the best for our happy event.
They even placed a chocolate message on our dessert which was so sweet of them. My wife had already taken some of the letters off without realizing it was a message. 😂.
This chocolate torte with superb cherries was unbelievable.
Highly recommended on all counts, venue, service and food.
customer_insights: The Gunton Arms is a cozy and upscale dining venue known for its romantic atmosphere and exceptional food, particularly its meat dishes cooked over an open fire. While it is ideal for special occasions like anniversaries and first dates, it may not suit larger group outings or late-night gatherings.

I came to AJ Gators on the recommendation of my sister, who couldn’t stop raving about their crab dip. I’m a huge fan of dips—spinach, buffalo chicken, you name it—so I was excited to check it out. This was my first time dining in, so I wasn’t sure what to expect, but we ordered two crab dips, one buffalo chicken dip, two grapefruit crushes (I believe), and a strawberry lemon drop.

The dips, unfortunately, came out lukewarm and weren’t as flavorful as I hoped. The buffalo chicken dip in particular was extremely creamy but lacked that bold chicken or sriracha flavor I was looking for. That said, it was pretty late when we came in, so I’ll give them the benefit of the doubt—timing may have played a part in the food not being at its best.

The real standout of the night was our server, Jessica (I believe that was her name). She was super sweet, attentive, and even brought us both pita bread and chips for our dips—which was a thoughtful touch since most places only offer one option.

The strawberry lemon drop was tasty, although I’m used to it being red and made with strawberry purée instead of just strawberry liqueur—but it was still enjoyable!

All in all, while the food didn’t quite meet my expectations this time, the great service and overall vibe would definitely bring me back to give it another try—hopefully a bit earlier next time!
