googleReviews: Friday fish special was good. An average portion and lunch for me but I'd have to get two for dinner. Jaliyah provided good service, gave recommendations, and checked on me often. I'd return again.

I LIKE (insert business name here),lol. This is my go to spot to just get away. My favorite waitress was not in attendance so I was forced to step out on her, sorry. All imma say is there may be a change for the number one spot. I saw team work and what appeared to be people actually enjoying their job. A young lady dropped somethings on the floor and immediately her co workers came to help. They even seemed to ease the anxiety I assume she would feel after dropping someones food. I loved that. O and the sweet tea was sweet. Thumbs up.

Let me start by saying Sydney the bartender is great, she provides great customer service!! Com'on Hooters ( corporate), lets get it together and turn things around!! Your brand quality has fallen off tremendously. I ordered 10 wings, but only ate 3. Stop with all of the gimmick giveaways to get customers to come in and focus on improving your quality. If a product is good quality, people will pay for it. Your offering all of these daily specials and AUCE on poor quality food to get people inside and its still not working. Hooters was once good fast food ( quality wise). Get it together corporate!!

Someone should pay attention to the condition of the tables. I was seated at a high top that had pealing urethane and a visible wad of gum on the corner.

I miss the old smoked wings. This new marinated fake smoke tastes bad.

I visited twice in one week and placed the same order; 10 smoked with spicy garlic. On the first day, there was no sauce on the wings at all. The waitress argued that the sauce was there. She brought me a side... the manager came by later and agreed, there was no sauce on the wings.
On the second visit there was sauce, but it was just dribbled lightly over the wings and the meat was under cooked.

The fride pickles were amazing on my first visit. Very crispy. On my second visit, they were soggy and raw.

A great place to catch football live and enjoy delicious wings and drinks. The drinks were absolutely delicious, the wings and appetizers were fresh and piping hot. The wings were amazing, the general tso's sauce is sweet and spicy, and their wings are perfectly crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. Our waitress was so kind and attentive all through our lunch and very personable. Always a favorite spot!
customer_insights: Hooters in Norfolk is a casual sports bar known for its lively atmosphere, making it a great spot for groups looking to enjoy wings and drinks while catching a game. While service quality varies, many patrons appreciate the attentive staff and the social vibe, though there are concerns about food consistency.

address: 344 Constitution Dr, Virginia Beach, VA 23462, USA
googleReviews:
Tonight (11/26) was my first night at this place. My server was a young lady who was pretty nice, but after serving me my drink & food, she kinda disappeared...?
It took a while for me to find her. I "literally" had to get up & go to the kitchen area, knock (loudly) on the wall, only to see her eating while I'm waiting to get my check...(?)
Anyhow, after a few more minutes, finally got my check and left.
Will I go again...Maybe?
I might be willing to give them another shot...?
This is a nice sports bar with great food!! Only wish it was larger.

The waitress got my order wrong, no worries. But both items were on the check when I went to close out. I pointed it out nicely, and she corrected it. The service overall wasn’t great though, but I still tipped. Now that the charge has fully went through my bank, I realize she must’ve changed the tip because I am showing a $4.00 discrepancy. (She tipped herself an additional $4.00) I definitely will not be coming back.

Just a terrific place.

Nice staff, good food, great sports bar atmosphere.

Packed crowd with three, maybe four servers on the floor. They were all smiles and cheers throughout the evening. Given the crowd, drinks were pretty prompt.

Tasted the fried cheese; the menu reads they batter them, and that's what they tasted like. Not your mother's mac n cheese; that's what they serve. Good job.

Love it when something happens in the game and a collective cheer or groan erupts from the crowd. That's a good sports bar crowd.

I'd come back. The server's name was Spaley, Taley, Valey, something like that. 😐

Fresh fried pickles were phenomenal.
Just missed happy hour, however had a few beers at the discounted rate.
Over 20 screens from basket ball to football and golf.
Great company with the locals and staff was very warming and welcoming.
Was a bit empty for a Monday I wS told , nonetheless had a great experience.
Would visit again in the future.
customer_insights: The Tailgate Sports Pub is a lively sports bar known for its great food and welcoming atmosphere. While service can be hit or miss, the overall vibe is friendly and energetic, making it a suitable spot for casual gatherings and game nights.

venueName: Peck & Pour, World Class Wings and Beer
address: 1310 Colley Ave, Norfolk, VA 23517, USA
googleReviews: Stopped in on a Saturday afternoon for a quick pint and saw they think highly of their wings, so we grabbed a small order just to see. They were perfectly tasty, no reason not to get them, but not something I'd go out of my way for. The place was mostly empty so service was fast. They have a nice selection of beers and had a fun cocktail menu. Decor was a typical bar atmosphere, if I had to guess this place is probably popular with the ODU crowd.

I love their food here, especially their breaded hot honey wings! Their rice bowls look so good too, I highly recommend. Anne was a lovely server, so was Allegra and Alana, great staff, great location, and amazing food!

Update: Amanda and Anne are also so lovely. And their rice bowls are good! I really love the friendly ladies behind the bar and their cesar dressing must be made in house. Their cesar salad is simple and DELICIOUS. I love it here. Cant wait to be back.
Love this place. Rainy night, but I wanted to venture out. Fun straight-up bar. Wings apps and beer. Great outdoor space, fun indoor space. Bar is big with wine beer and mix drinks.
4 of my 6  mozzarella sticks literally have no cheese, thank for wasting 40 minutes and my money. Second time Ive been there to waste my time and money, Highly DO NOT recommend!

Stopped in for dinner, we got the wing platter, the mozzarella sticks were absolutely nasty; the wings jumbo.  , have flavor , just bad quality meat . The floor was very sticky in the dining area. Overall this was a bad experience. . The drinks took 15-20 min to come out, I wouldn’t recommend.  Honestly you can make better food in a microwave
customer_insights: Peck & Pour is a casual sports bar known for its wings and beer selection, appealing mainly to the ODU crowd. While the atmosphere is lively and suitable for pregame or casual outings, there are mixed reviews regarding food quality and service consistency.

address: 4848 Virginia Beach Blvd, Virginia Beach, VA 23462, USA
googleReviews: DJ  is same on all Karaoke nights: likes to hear himself sing.. Plays songs when singers are waiting. Only has 1 mic.  Bren, waitress is fantastic and beautiful.   Food prices increased and menu never changed during the year of going there every weekend. Miss going there but not with the  problems described.

Service was great.  We used to go every weekend for Karokee.  One D J  same on both nights.  Worries more about himself singing  then guests.  Same old  music.  Prices on food was raised.  Nothing new on menu.

Had the sampler, price was right, the sauces were standard, the fries were a bit bland.
Over all  not bad , they have foot ball specials all week long 25 cent wings during games, that a plus..
2 stars..

Came in while it was open. Knew a hole in the wall will be less busy which I was correct. Wanted to chill and have a good time. No time displayed saying they was closing soon (12am).  We thought they close at 2 as the other hole in the wall. We left when we was told we close in 5 minutes after we asked for change to play pool. We left at the beginning of the
game because we felt super uncomfortable. When we left, we asked a guy outside smoking if he is a manger, he said yes. We asked why isn’t there a sign of your open to close time, he said you should of asked. Great answer manager.

Please Read: If you are a person of color or not a local DO NOT GO HERE.

I'm in the Navy and came to VA for some training. I came with 2 other guys. We were not greeted when we came in. We sat at a table and it took awhile for someone to see us. The woman who came to see us did not want to serve us. She gave very racist vibes. She did not want to even be close to us at the table and her attitude was as if we had the "ick".
I have no sympathy for people like this!
All 3 of us picked up on it and it was very uncomfortable.

Only got a beverage and then left after we paid.

DO NOT COME HERE!
customer_insights: The Frog Sports Bar & Grill offers a casual and lively atmosphere ideal for sports fans and karaoke enthusiasts. However, there are significant concerns regarding service quality, food pricing, and inclusivity, which may deter potential patrons.

address: 5444 Greenwich Rd, Virginia Beach, VA 23462, USA
googleReviews: We had a small company event at Topgolf and I honestly had a blast. The vibe was great everyone was super friendly and welcoming. The staff especially the younger waiters were on point some of the most professional folks I’ve met in the 757. The only downside was the food it was a bit bland and definitely on the pricey side which caught me off guard. But aside from that no complaints. It’s definitely a fun spot and a solid place to take someone special on a date!

Got a spot no problem! I’ve been here a few times in the past and it normally takes a while to get anywhere but they definitely have streamlined things! Drinks were DELICIOUS and strong without tasting bad. I am a stickler for a good drink and was very impressed. Also I didn’t want to order and food but my fiancé was starving. Even the food was good! Our waiter was amazing as well (beautiful curly hair). We had a blast for our date night and will be back more regularly!

Very fun afternoon spent playing golf, eating and drinking. The entire place is a little pricey but it is worth it when you get the convenience of having everything together! It is definitely more worth it if you have more people to split the cost of the bays or if you are able to visit on a weekday. Friendly wait staff and quick food/drink service. Would recommend this location!

Went for a Valentine’s Day brunch our host  Hayden showed us great hospitality tacos & mimosas was on point they had a Valentine’s Day red golf ball event even tho we didn’t win we enjoyed our time definitely going again
5 ⭐️ to 2 :
The waiter was cool
But the ppl bringing the food & drinks out left carts with our food on the side trying to figure out what bay it go to flys landing on the food (see pictures) it didn’t get 1 star cuz the kids still had fun .

Love coming here. Such a fun thing to do. The games are fun, and people of all skill levels can find one they are good at, even kids. My kids are 15 and 12 and love it too. Servers are friendly and food is great too. Highly recommend!
customer_insights: Topgolf Virginia Beach offers a vibrant atmosphere perfect for groups and dates alike. While the food has received mixed reviews regarding taste and price, the overall experience of golfing, strong drinks, and friendly service makes it a popular choice for both casual outings and special occasions.

address: 7924 Chesapeake Blvd, Norfolk, VA 23518, USA
googleReviews:
New to the area.. found this gem.
Phenomenal food at affordable price point.
It's definitely a vibe for sure! Bar tenders are very welcoming. Very chill environment for food and drinks.

All around great place , the group of " Cowboys From Hell " that sit at end of the bar by the front door are absolutely halairious . the service was very prompt , the drinks were on point and oh my god.... The food was outstanding. The bartender ( Bobbie ) that served me & my friends is very personable & witty. All in all my friend had a great time & we will be going back .

After hearing all the positive comments about the food at Harbor Inn we decided to check it out for dinner. Hubs had the NY strip and I had a ribeye, both were so flavorful and cooked perfectly! We thanked Leslie for preparing such delicious meals for us, we could tell that she takes pride in her work and she does it so well! With dinner being such a positive experience we figured we should try brunch next, Pam was our server/bar tender on both visits, she was hustling while providing great service with a friendly disposition! I enjoyed the French toast & sausage links (only $8) and hubs had the ham steak & eggs special ($11) so good & very reasonably priced! We definitely recommend Harbor Inn for yummy food at fair prices & economical beverages! The backroom is non-smoking which we appreciate.

Worst bartenders around. They are hateful and incompetent. But I guess that's what you get in norfolk. Seek other employment ladies. Preferably one that doesn't deal with the public. Even though food is actually good I won't spend my money just because of the horrible bartenders.
Bar was pretty full and Bar Tender was on point! Everyone was having fun. Food was fantastic and prices were amazing! I will be back for sure. Great Labor Day afternoon. 😀
customer_insights: Harbor Inn is a casual and welcoming venue known for its affordable and delicious food. While the atmosphere is lively and fun, some reviews mention inconsistent service from bartenders, which could affect the overall experience.

address: 2330 Bowdens Ferry Rd Suite 600, Norfolk, VA 23508, USA
googleReviews:
Had an amazing experience at the Afterglow winter market! Loved seeing the community come out and shop at all the local business vendors!

Amazing back patio by the railroads (safe for kids!), tons of parking, super family & pet friendly, amazing staff, even better atmosphere!

Can't wait to go back and get a Holy Cannoli!

6/6/25 - Nice spacious area outside by the railroad tracks. I went during a flea market event. Parking was a little slim due to the event.  They had 2 different food trucks. It seems they have a signature frozen drink but I was unable to get. I was told ten minutes and already ordered another drink and the people next to us just ordered it and were able to get it, which kind of annoyed me. 🫣 The line starts at the entry of the front door. There is some merch by the front door as well. They did have an additional outdoor bar with only a selection drinks. But the staff was nice. The outdoor space is very spacious. I didn't get to try any foods but would still come back for the outdoor seating/environment.

Nice, friendly venue with live music and tonight the Food Truck for eats was AMAZING! 757LoasStrretFood 😋 The Meat Salad, the Pancit, the Rubbed Wings, the Pork Eggrolls, the Chicken Skewers...ALL DELICIOUS!!! 😋

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!
Beer is amazing I can drink them all. Staff was very friendly and attentive. Outdoor space is great plenty of room for kids to play.

We had a great time at Afterglow. The brewery is modern, clean, and welcoming on the inside. They have a great outdoor space and a tented patio which was perfect on a rainy day. I’m not a huge beer drinker but the bartender was able to recommend some beers for me to try. I ended up getting a flight and enjoyed each one. They have a diverse menu so there is something for everyone. The seltzers were also so good and they had lots of flavors to choose from. It’s definitely family friendly and I felt comfortable with my infant there (bonus points for the clean changing tables in both bathrooms). They have some games and activities for older kids as well. We’ll definitely be coming back!
customer_insights: Afterglow Brewing is a family-friendly brewery with a spacious outdoor area and a welcoming atmosphere. Customers appreciate the live music, food trucks, and community events, making it a great spot for casual gatherings with friends and family.

address: 1129 Boissevain Ave, Norfolk, VA 23507, USA
googleReviews:
Went here on Sunday with my girlfriend, my kids, and a couple of friends.

This was my first time here.

Located in the hip brewery rich Chelsea area of Norfolk, lies Benchtop Brewery. This is your standard local brewery serving your standard brew variations. It wasn’t bad by any means. It just didn’t stand out in a very long list of local brewery’s.

We had a flight of four beers. We had a gose, porter, pale ale, and lager. None were bad. I particularly liked the Jam Pact Raspberry Gose as I have a taste for Gose’s. In fact, they have quite an interesting selections of Gose’s that might be the very reason why I go back.

On this particular day, they had Hashi food truck on site. I will try to find a place to do a review for them specifically, but I can tell you the food was very well done.

I mentioned that I brought my kids with me. A lot of brewery’s have a family environment, but I don’t feel that this is one of them. All my kids could do was play in the parking lot next to the patio and hang on the railings on the patio. I say that to say I wouldn’t bring my children back here.

Modern and cozy brewery. This is a great place if you're looking for a unique take on beer. It's a nice place to hang out with friends and family. There's inside seating and outdoor covered table seating. Outdoor seating is great during nice weather, and locals like to bring their pets. We came on a Sunday and made it just in time to catch the Hashi Chow food truck and bought the last 2 rice bowls left. There's limited parking around the site. I tried their beer called 1000 zombies, very refreshing and unique. There's also themed pinball machines and an old Ms PacMan and Galaga arcade machine.

Small(ish) brewery that still had plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. I loved the half pour option so I could try more, and the "to-go" cooler had some additional styles. Parking in the lot was limited, but I don't think street parking would be bad during their normal hours. The bartenders were incredibly knowledgeable and friendly.  Overall a great experience!

Fuller's Raw Bar in Phoebus had the Proven Theory on draft and it was freaking amazing. We went back at least 3 times so I could have it again. Not too hoppy, not too citrusy, not to thick like some hazys can be... Just absolutely delicious. We're on our way back to Pittsburgh and I'm super bummed I won't get to have it again. It was delicious.
Maybe our best brewery experience during our entire Virginia getaway. Amazing beer and super friendly staff. So many foeder aged beers on tap!
customer_insights: Benchtop Brewing Company offers a casual and friendly atmosphere, making it a great spot for pregame gatherings or a laid-back night out with friends. While it may not be ideal for families with young children, it features a unique selection of beers, including a notable Gose, and often hosts food trucks for added dining options.

address: 1309 Raleigh Ave, Norfolk, VA 23507, USA
googleReviews: Vast beer selections with many different styles. I had the Goatskull dopple bock and then the Holiday Helper. Both beers were excellent and flavorful. They had two different food trucks outside and some chicken quesadillas hit the spot. There was a small local craft fair going on this day in the larger side room where I picked up some gifts and connected with some new friends. This is a unique big little brewery where it’s hard not to have a good time.
Love Smartmouth!! Bummed the Norfolk location is closing but the Pilot House in VB is great, as well! Pizza is on-site at the Pilot House and the atmosphere is always nice!

Convenient location with many flavorful takes on lagers, IPAs, other styles. The seasonal offerings are usually on-point and haven’t disappointed us yet. The atmosphere is congenial with a generational mix of folks. Missed their Alter Ego Saison, but the other beers are worth trying.
Cool place with great beer and a fun enviroment. Me and my brother won a best of three games series of foosball during my visit. A triumphant experience that we will never forget.

Smartmouth has awesome beers and a great atmosphere. They are taking the social distancing seriously with masks requires, hand sanitizer available and spaced out tables indoors and out with open air in the garage. The employees are super nice and very attentive to cleaning. Great location and easy to walk to if you are local. Pups are allowed as well. Same for the little ones. Definitely would recommend!
customer_insights: Smartmouth Brewing Co. offers a vibrant atmosphere with a diverse selection of craft beers and food trucks, making it a popular spot for social gatherings. The brewery is known for its friendly environment and community events, appealing to both locals and visitors looking for a fun night out.

address: 5104 Colley Ave, Norfolk, VA 23508, USA
googleReviews: The atmosphere of this brewery is wonderful — warm and inviting. The food was absolutely delicious, and the staff was very polite and attentive. The location is excellent, making it a perfect spot to enjoy both great flavors and a great setting. I usually never drink beer — maybe once a year — but even I tried a couple of sips here, and it was surprisingly delicious!
My colleagues and I frequent Elations for lunch and it's one of our to-go places for evening get togethers. Staff is always friendly and I have enjoyed all of the variety of pizzas so far.

We were tourists visiting from Canada and out for a bike ride and came upon this fabulous spot for lunch. It’s a great place for families and friends to get together. Dog friendly as well. Children were playing and having fun while live band played in the background. The pizzas are amazing and the beer selection is great. The staff were fabulous as well.
Pizza is good but you can get the exact same pizza with better service at the bake house on Chelsea. They really miss the mark with the service here. Voyager coffee shop on the other hand is great.

Great beer, the whole place smells amazing with the combination of the pizza and the smoked meats.
We walked in tonight to a great rock band. The place was crowded (Friday night) but the staff was extremely accommodating in helping us find a seat.
Parking unfortunately is not great. Currently they allow parking across the street at 5215 Colley Ave
customer_insights: Elation Brewing is a vibrant and inviting brewery in Norfolk, known for its delicious pizzas and great beer selection. The atmosphere is lively, making it a popular spot for both locals and tourists, with live music enhancing the experience. While some reviews mention service inconsistencies, the overall sentiment highlights a friendly staff and a welcoming environment.

address: 735 E 23rd St, Norfolk, VA 23504, USA
googleReviews: I admit that I found out about this Norfolk Virginia Makers Craft and Brewery location after hearing about it referenced via people at my current place of employment. I took a chance with going there less than 8 hours ago.  I tried a black cherry shandy which was delicious and the employee helping me to select the order was highly polite. It was tempting to order another beer. However I felt myself get a light buzz after just one drink and I chose to voluntarily restrain myself tonight for personal reasons. There was a Rosa's Lumpia truck outside of the restaurant and I chose to order 4 pieces of lumpia which I received with sweet chili sauce which was also delicious and luckily that food helped to soak up the beer I was enjoying. The employees handling my food order were friendly and cheerful towards me even with I being slightly buzzed. Obviously I intend to keep an open mind to returning and I am glad to have tried some of the beer with some lumpia on the side.

Went to the Vintage fest this afternoon.  Was wonderful.  The beer was good too.  I had the Sweet Stout and Echo Bourbon Barrel beer.  I liked both very much.  Parking is terrible but there is an event. So it might be better on normal days.  A great afternoon!!!!
Wonderfully friendly service from Michelle (Brew Pub) & Brandon (Cigar Lounge). I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Plus, tasty beers, with a wide selection. Thank you!
Just visited here attended the Vintage Market and decided to grab some of their local ale ( NECTARON of the Gods ) to go with the Mac Bbq bowl it’s another nice local place to visit

Great spot to get drinks and hang out, does smell a bit like cigars thoughtout the whole area, they do have a cigar room, which for some is a plus not me. They have seasonal beers that are good I had the pumpkin lager, that and the craft sodas are also good the root beer and cherry are both must trys
customer_insights: Maker's Craft Brewery offers a casual and friendly atmosphere with a variety of local beers and food options, including food trucks. While it may not be ideal for romantic dates or anniversaries, it's a great spot for pregame drinks or a night out with friends.

address: 116 E 25th St, Norfolk, VA 23517, USA
googleReviews: Great little micro brewery in a cool area of Norfolk. My favorite beer was the Tunnel Traffic but they were all delicious. Friendly staff, clean bathrooms, close to lots of other breweries and restaurants.

I highly recommend this place. Rip Rap was a very nice brewery which presented a much different experience than normal. A very relaxed atmosphere with plenty of seating for the day we went. All inside seating, unfortunately no food or food truck on site. However, they had all sorts of games available to play and cheap merchandise. Will be returning here in the near future

Beer was good and reasonably priced, atmosphere is fairly sparse and small. Couple adirondack chairs in front allow you to take in the view of the heating and air conditioning place across the street. Website could use some updating, adding a pic of the menu so folks know what they have on draft here.
This place is a fantastic place to relax and get a beer. It is small and homey. One of the better places to get a beer in Norfolk. 10/10!
The space and vibe reminded me of hanging out in a friend's garage, super laid back and inviting. We tried the red IPA and the peach gose and both were great. Definitely will be back!
customer_insights: Rip Rap Brewing Co. offers a relaxed and inviting atmosphere, making it a great spot for casual hangouts. While it lacks food options, the variety of beers and games available create a fun environment for friends looking to unwind.
